title_en: Rethinking the Hardness of PbRL: A Provable General Regret Bound
title_zh: 重新思考 PbRL 的难度：一个可证明的一般遗憾界

sentences.en: This paper studies \emph{preference-based reinforcement learning} (PbRL), where agents learn from comparative, trajectory-level feedback rather than numeric rewards.
sentences.zh: 本文研究 \emph{preference-based reinforcement learning}（PbRL，基于偏好的强化学习），其中智能体从比较性的、轨迹级别的反馈中学习，而非数字奖励。

sentences.en: While PbRL has seen rapid empirical and theoretical progress, existing analyses are largely confined to restricted settings and fail to jointly capture the outcome-based and comparison-based nature of preference feedback.
sentences.zh: 虽然 PbRL 在经验与理论上都取得了快速的进展，但现有分析大多局限于受限的设置，未能联合捕捉偏好反馈的基于结果与基于比较的双重性质。

sentences.en: We prove that under a broad \emph{general function approximation} framework, PbRL admits a $\sqrt{T}$ regret guarantee.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，在一个宽泛的 \emph{general function approximation}（一般函数近似）框架下，PbRL 承认一个 $\sqrt{T}$ 的遗憾保证。

sentences.en: In particular, we introduce a simple and provably efficient algorithm, \emph{Recursive Trajectory-based Preference Q-Learning} (RTPQ), and establish its regret bound while explicitly accounting for the trajectory-level and comparative structure of preferences.
sentences.zh: 特别地，我们引入一个简单且可证明高效的算法，\emph{Recursive Trajectory-based Preference Q-Learning}（RTPQ，递归轨迹偏好 Q 学习），并在显式地考虑偏好的轨迹级与比较性结构的同时确立其遗憾界。

sentences.en: Our analysis is characterized by a new complexity measure, the \emph{Dual Episodic Eluder Dimension} (DEED), which quantifies the intrinsic difficulty of PbRL.
sentences.zh: 我们的分析以一个新型复杂度度量，\emph{Dual Episodic Eluder Dimension}（DEED，对偶情节 Eluder 维数）为特征，它量化了 PbRL 的内在难度。

sentences.en: We show that for linear MDPs, the DEED scales as $\mathcal{O}(dH)$, yielding a regret bound of $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(dH\sqrt{T}\max(H^{3/2},\,1/\kappa))$, where $\kappa$ is a problem-dependent constant.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，对于线性 MDP，DEED 的规模为 $\mathcal{O}(dH)$，从而产生遗憾界 $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(dH\sqrt{T}\max(H^{3/2},\,1/\kappa))$，其中 $\kappa$ 是一个与问题相关的常数。

sentences.en: This bound is near-optimal up to horizon- and problem-dependent factors when compared to standard reward-based linear MDPs.
sentences.zh: 与标准的基于奖励的线性 MDP 相比，该界在视界与问题相关因子的范围内是接近最优的。

sentences.en: In addition, our framework recovers the best-known regret bounds in the special cases of dueling bandits and standard outcome-based reinforcement learning.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们的框架在结对老虎机与标准基于结果的强化学习等特殊情形下恢复了已知最佳的遗憾界。

sentences.en: Overall, our results provide a general regret guarantee for PbRL with outcome-based preference feedback and broad function approximation.
sentences.zh: 总而言之，我们的结果为带基于结果偏好反馈与宽泛函数近似的 PbRL 提供了一个一般的遗憾保证。

title_en: Rethinking the Reranker: Boundary-Aware Evidence Selection for Robust Retrieval-Augmented Generation
title_zh: 重新思考重排序器：面向稳健检索增强生成的边界感知证据选择

sentences.en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems remain brittle under realistic retrieval noise, even when the required evidence appears in the top-$K$ results.
sentences.zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）系统在现实的检索噪声下仍然脆弱，即使所需的证据出现在 top-$K$ 结果中也是如此。

sentences.en: A key reason is that retrievers and rerankers optimize solely for relevance, often selecting either trivial, answer-revealing passages or evidence that lacks the critical information required to answer the question, without considering whether the evidence is suitable for the generator.
sentences.zh: 一个关键原因是检索器与重排序器仅针对相关性进行优化，往往要么选择琐碎的、暴露答案的段落，要么选择缺乏回答该问题所需关键信息的证据，而没有考虑该证据是否适合生成器。

sentences.en: We propose \texttt{BAR-RAG}, which reframes the reranker as a boundary-aware evidence selector that targets the generator’s Goldilocks Zone—evidence that is neither trivially easy nor fundamentally unanswerable for the generator, but is challenging yet sufficient for inference and thus provides the strongest learning signal.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 \texttt{BAR-RAG}，它将重排序器重构为一个边界感知的证据选择器，瞄准生成器的金凤花区（Goldilocks Zone）——即对生成器而言既不琐碎简单、也非根本上无法回答，而是具有挑战性却又足以支持推理并因此提供最强学习信号的证据。

sentences.en: \texttt{BAR-RAG} trains the selector with reinforcement learning using generator feedback, and adopts a two-stage pipeline that fine-tunes the generator under the induced evidence distribution to mitigate the distribution mismatch between training and inference.
sentences.zh: \texttt{BAR-RAG} 利用生成器反馈通过强化学习训练选择器，并采用两阶段流水线，在诱导的证据分布下微调生成器，以缓解训练与推理之间的分布失配。

sentences.en: Experiments on knowledge-intensive question answering benchmarks show that \texttt{BAR-RAG} consistently improves end-to-end performance under noisy retrieval, achieving an average gain of 10.3\% over strong RAG and reranking baselines while substantially improving robustness.
sentences.zh: 在知识密集型问答基准上的实验表明，\texttt{BAR-RAG} 在噪声检索下持续提升端到端性能，相比强 RAG 与重排序基线取得了 10.3\% 的平均提升，同时显著改善了鲁棒性。

authors.name: Saizhuo Wang
authors.institution: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

title_en: Rethinking the Trust Region in LLM Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: 重新思考 LLM 强化学习中的信任区域

sentences.en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a cornerstone for fine-tuning Large Language Models (LLMs), with Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) serving as the de facto standard algorithm.
sentences.zh: 强化学习（RL）已成为微调大语言模型（LLM）的基石，其中近端策略优化（PPO）是事实上标准的算法。

sentences.en: Despite its ubiquity, we argue that the core ratio clipping mechanism in PPO is structurally ill-suited for the large vocabularies inherent to LLMs.
sentences.zh: 尽管它无处不在，我们认为 PPO 中核心的比率裁剪机制在结构上并不适合 LLM 固有的巨大词汇表。

sentences.en: PPO constrains policy updates based on the probability ratio of sampled tokens, which serves as a noisy single-sample Monte Carlo estimate of the true policy divergence.
sentences.zh: PPO 基于采样词元的概率比率来约束策略更新，该比率作为真实策略散度的一个有噪声的单样本蒙特卡洛估计。

sentences.en: This creates a sub-optimal learning dynamic: updates to low-probability tokens are aggressively over-penalized, while potentially catastrophic shifts in high-probability tokens are under-constrained, leading to training inefficiency and instability.
sentences.zh: 这造成了一种次优的学习动态：对低概率词元的更新被激进地过度惩罚，而对高概率词元可能发生的灾难性偏移却约束不足，从而导致训练低效与不稳定。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose Divergence Proximal Policy Optimization (DPPO), which substitutes heuristic clipping with a more principled constraint based on a direct estimate of policy divergence (e.g., Total Variation or KL).
sentences.zh: 为应对这一问题，我们提出散度近端策略优化（Divergence Proximal Policy Optimization，DPPO），它用基于策略散度（例如总变差或 KL）直接估计的、更有原则性的约束取代启发式裁剪。

sentences.en: To avoid huge memory footprint, we introduce the efficient Binary and Top-K approximations to capture the essential divergence with negligible overhead.
sentences.zh: 为避免巨大的内存占用，我们引入高效的二进制与 Top-K 近似，以可忽略的开销捕获核心散度。

sentences.en: Extensive empirical evaluations demonstrate that DPPO achieves superior stability and efficiency compared to existing methods, offering a more robust foundation for RL-based LLM fine-tuning.
sentences.zh: 广泛的实证评估表明，DPPO 相比现有方法实现了更优越的稳定性与效率，为基于 RL 的 LLM 微调提供了更稳健的基础。

sentences.en: Our code is available at \url{https://github.com/sail-sg/Stable-RL}.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 \url{https://github.com/sail-sg/Stable-RL} 获取。

authors.name: Xiangxin Zhou
authors.institution: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences

title_en: Rethinking Thinking Tokens: LLMs as Improvement Operators
title_zh: 重新思考思考词元：将 LLM 作为改进算子

sentences.en: Reasoning training incentivizes LLMs to produce long chains of thought (long CoT), which among other things, allows them to explore solution strategies with self-checking.
sentences.zh: 推理训练激励 LLM 生成长思维链（长 CoT），除其他能力外，这还使它们能够在带自我检查的情况下探索各种求解策略。

sentences.en: This results in higher accuracy, but inflates context length, token/compute cost, and answer latency.
sentences.zh: 这带来了更高的准确率，但膨胀了上下文长度、词元/计算成本与回答延迟。

sentences.en: We ask: Can current models leverage their metacognition to provide other combinations on this Pareto frontier, e.g., better accuracy with lower context length and/or latency?
sentences.zh: 我们要问：当前模型能否利用其元认知，在这一帕累托前沿上提供其他组合，例如在更低的上下文长度与/或延迟下获得更好的准确率？

sentences.en: Abstractly, we view the model as an improvement operator on its own "thoughts" with a continuum of possible strategies.
sentences.zh: 抽象地看，我们将模型视为其自身“想法”上的改进算子，拥有一个包含多种可能策略的连续谱。

sentences.en: We identify an interesting inference family Parallel-Distill-Refine (PDR), which performs the following: (i) generate diverse drafts in parallel; (ii) distill them into a bounded, textual workspace; and (iii) refine conditioned on this workspace, producing an output that seeds the next round.
sentences.zh: 我们识别出一个有趣的推理族：并行-蒸馏-细化（Parallel-Distill-Refine，PDR），它执行以下操作：（i）并行生成多样草稿；（ii）将它们蒸馏到一个有界的文本工作空间；以及（iii）在此工作空间条件下进行细化，产生为下一轮提供种子的输出。

sentences.en: Importantly, context length (hence compute cost) is controllable via degree of parallelism, and is no longer conflated with the total number of generated tokens.
sentences.zh: 重要的是，上下文长度（从而计算成本）可以通过并行度来控制，而不再与生成的词元总数混为一谈。

sentences.en: We report PDR instantiations of current models that give better accuracy than long CoT while incurring lower latency.
sentences.zh: 我们报告了当前模型的 PDR 实例化，它们以更低的延迟取得了优于长 CoT 的准确率。

sentences.en: Setting degree of parallelism to 1 yields an interesting subcase, Sequential Refinement (SR) (iteratively improve a single candidate answer) which provides performance superior to long CoT. Success of such model orchestrations raises the question whether further training could shift the Pareto frontier.
sentences.zh: 将并行度设为 1 会产生一个有趣的子情形，即序列细化（Sequential Refinement，SR）（迭代改进单个候选答案），它提供了优于长 CoT 的性能。此类模型编排的成功引发了一个问题：进一步的训练能否移动帕累托前沿。

sentences.en: To this end, we train an 8B thinking model with Reinforcement Learning (RL) to make it consistent with PDR as the inference method.
sentences.zh: 为此，我们用强化学习（RL）训练一个 8B 思考模型，使其与 PDR 作为推理方法保持一致。

sentences.en: On math tasks with verifiable answers, iterative pipelines surpass single-pass baselines at matched sequential budgets, with PDR delivering the largest gains (e.g., +11% on AIME 2024 and +9% on AIME 2025).
sentences.zh: 在带可验证答案的数学任务上，迭代流水线在匹配的顺序预算下超越了单次基线，其中 PDR 带来了最大的提升（例如，AIME 2024 上 +11% 与 AIME 2025 上 +9%）。

title_en: Rethinking Time-Series Imputation as Conditional Inference along Temporal Evolution
title_zh: 重新思考时间序列插补：将其作为沿时序演化的条件推断

sentences.en: Real-world time-series data often suffer from missing observations, hindering long-range temporal modeling.
sentences.zh: 真实世界的时间序列数据常常遭受缺失观测之苦，这阻碍了长程的时序建模。

sentences.en: However, most existing imputation methods formulate imputation as conditional reconstruction over limited context, which restricts temporal information propagation and fails to explicitly model temporal evolution.
sentences.zh: 然而，大多数现有的插补方法将插补形式化为在有限上下文上的条件重建，这限制了时序信息的传播，并未能显式建模时序演化。

sentences.en: To overcome this limitation, we propose the Conditional Temporal Inference Paradigm (CTIP), which formulates time-series imputation as conditional inference along temporal evolution.
sentences.zh: 为克服这一局限，我们提出条件时序推断范式（Conditional Temporal Inference Paradigm，CTIP），它将时间序列插补形式化为沿时序演化的条件推断。

sentences.en: Under this paradigm, we introduce CBiT, which leverages a history compression mechanism to encode long-range history into a compact latent space for history-conditioned temporal imputation.
sentences.zh: 在该范式下，我们引入 CBiT，它利用一种历史压缩机制，将长程历史编码到一个紧凑的潜在空间中，以进行历史条件化的时序插补。

sentences.en: In addition, we adopt a partitioned modeling strategy that distinguishes historical context and temporal imputation targets with only linear-time complexity.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们采用一种分区建模策略，仅以线性时间复杂度即可区分历史上下文与时序插补目标。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on multiple public benchmarks show that CBiT improves imputation accuracy by reducing Masked MAE and Masked RMSE by 27.3% and 18.6%, respectively, across different missing rates.
sentences.zh: 在多个公开基准上的大量实验表明，CBiT 通过将 Masked MAE 与 Masked RMSE 分别降低 27.3% 与 18.6%，在不同的缺失率下提升了插补准确率。

title_en: Rethinking Video Generation Model for the Embodied World
title_zh: 为具身世界重新思考视频生成模型

sentences.en: While video generation holds promise for embodied intelligence, current video models struggle with physical realism, and progress is hindered by the lack of standardized benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 虽然视频生成对具身智能抱有前景，但当前的视频模型在物理真实性方面表现不佳，而且进展受到缺乏标准化基准的阻碍。

sentences.en: To address this gap, we introduce a comprehensive robotics benchmark, RBench, designed to evaluate robot-oriented video generation across five task domains and four distinct embodiments.
sentences.zh: 为填补这一空白，我们引入一个全面的机器人基准 RBench，旨在跨五个任务域与四种不同的具身形态评估面向机器人的视频生成。

sentences.en: By assessing task correctness and visual fidelity through reproducible metrics, our evaluation of 25 models reveals significant deficiencies in generating physically realistic robot behaviors.
sentences.zh: 通过可复现的指标评估任务正确性与视觉保真度，我们对 25 个模型的评估揭示了它们在生成物理上真实的机器人行为方面存在显著缺陷。

sentences.en: Furthermore, the benchmark achieves a 0.96 Spearman correlation with human judgment, validating its effectiveness.
sentences.zh: 此外，该基准与人类判断达到 0.96 的 Spearman 相关系数，验证了其有效性。

sentences.en: While RBench provides the necessary lens to identify these deficiencies, achieving physical realism requires moving beyond evaluation to address the critical shortage of high-quality training data.
sentences.zh: 虽然 RBench 提供了识别这些缺陷所需的透镜，但实现物理真实性需要超越评估，去解决高质量训练数据严重短缺的问题。

sentences.en: Driven by these insights, we introduce a refined four-stage data pipeline, resulting in RoVid-X, the largest open-source robotic dataset for video generation with 4 million annotated video clips, covering thousands of tasks and enriched with physical property annotations.
sentences.zh: 受这些洞见的驱动，我们引入一个精炼的四阶段数据流水线，最终形成 RoVid-X，用于视频生成的、最大规模的开源机器人数据集，包含 400 万个带注释的视频片段，覆盖数千个任务，并附带物理属性注释。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that finetuning on RoVid-X yields consistent performance gains.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，在 RoVid-X 上进行微调能带来一致性的性能提升。

sentences.en: Collectively, this synergistic ecosystem of evaluation and data establishes a robust foundation for rigorous assessment and scalable training of video models, accelerating the evolution of embodied AI toward physical intelligence.
sentences.zh: 总而言之，这种评估与数据的协同生态为视频模型的严格评估与可扩展训练奠定了坚实的基础，加速了具身 AI 向物理智能的演进。

sentences.en: The code and video demos are available in the supplementary materials.
sentences.zh: 代码与视频演示可在补充材料中获取。

authors.name: Zhou Daquan
authors.institution: National University of Singapore, Insititute of Data Science, Learning and Vision Lab

title_en: Rethinking Visual Autoregressive Sampling with Information-Grounding Guidance
title_zh: 用信息锚定引导重新思考视觉自回归采样

sentences.en: Autoregressive (AR) models based on next-scale prediction are rapidly emerging as a powerful tool for image generation, but they face a critical weakness: information inconsistencies between patches across timesteps introduced by progressive resolution scaling.
sentences.zh: 基于下一尺度预测的自回归（AR）模型正迅速成为图像生成的强大工具，但它们面临一个关键弱点：渐进式分辨率缩放所引入的各时间步之间补丁之间的信息不一致。

sentences.en: These inconsistencies scatter guidance signals, causing them to drift away from conditioning information and leaving behind ambiguous, unfaithful features.
sentences.zh: 这些不一致令引导信号分散，使其偏离条件信息，并留下模糊、不忠实的特征。

sentences.en: We tackle this challenge with Information-Grounding Guidance (IGG), a novel mechanism that anchors guidance to semantically important regions through attention.
sentences.zh: 我们以信息锚定引导（Information-Grounding Guidance，IGG）来应对这一挑战，这是一种通过注意力将引导锚定到语义重要区域的新机制。

sentences.en: By adaptively reinforcing informative patches during sampling, IGG ensures that guidance and content remain tightly aligned.
sentences.zh: 通过在采样期间自适应地强化信息丰富的补丁，IGG 确保引导与内容保持紧密对齐。

sentences.en: Across both class-conditioned and text-to-image generation tasks, IGG delivers sharper, more coherent, and semantically grounded images, setting a new benchmark for AR-based methods.
sentences.zh: 在类条件与文本到图像生成任务中，IGG 都提供了更锐利、更连贯且语义有根据的图像，为基于 AR 的方法树立了新的基准。

authors.name: Xiuying Wang
authors.institution: University of Sydney, University of Sydney

title_en: Rethinking Visual Intelligence: Insights from Video Pretraining
title_zh: 重新思考视觉智能：来自视频预训练的洞见

sentences.en: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated that large-scale pretraining enables systems to adapt rapidly to new problems with little supervision in the language domain.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）已经证明，大规模预训练能使系统在语言领域以很少的监督快速适应新问题。

sentences.en: This success, however, has not translated as effectively to the visual domain, where models, including LLMs, continue to struggle with compositional understanding, sample efficiency, and general-purpose problem-solving.
sentences.zh: 然而，这一成功尚未同样有效地转化到视觉领域，在视觉领域中，包括 LLM 在内的模型仍然在组合理解、样本效率与通用问题求解上挣扎。

sentences.en: We investigate Video Diffusion Models (VDMs) as a promising direction for bridging this gap.
sentences.zh: 我们研究视频扩散模型（VDM），将其作为弥合这一差距的一个有前途的方向。

sentences.en: Pretraining on spatiotemporal data endows these models with strong inductive biases for structure and dynamics, which we hypothesize can support broad task adaptability.
sentences.zh: 在时空数据上预训练赋予这些模型针对结构与动力学的强归纳偏置，我们假设这可以支撑广泛的任务适应性。

sentences.en: To test this, we design a controlled evaluation in which both a pretrained LLM and a pretrained VDM are equipped with lightweight adapters and presented with tasks in their natural modalities.
sentences.zh: 为验证这一点，我们设计了一个受控评估，其中预训练 LLM 与预训练 VDM 都配备轻量级适配器，并在其自然模态中呈现任务。

sentences.en: Across benchmarks including ARC-AGI, ConceptARC, visual games, route planning, and cellular automata, VDMs demonstrate higher data efficiency than their language counterparts.
sentences.zh: 在包括 ARC-AGI、ConceptARC、视觉博弈、路径规划与元胞自动机在内的基准上，VDM 表现出比其语言对应模型更高的数据效率。

sentences.en: Taken together, our results indicate that video pretraining offers inductive biases that support progress toward visual foundation models.
sentences.zh: 综合来看，我们的结果表明，视频预训练所提供的归纳偏置，支持了通往视觉基础模型的进展。

title_en: Retrieval-Aware Distillation for Transformer-SSM Hybrids
title_zh: 面向 Transformer-SSM 混合模型的检索感知蒸馏

sentences.en: State-space models (SSMs) offer efficient sequence modeling but lag behind Transformers on benchmarks that require in-context retrieval.
sentences.zh: 状态空间模型（SSM）提供高效的序列建模，但在需要上下文检索的基准上落后于 Transformers。

sentences.en: Prior work links this gap to a small set of attention heads, termed Gather-and-Aggregate (G&A), which SSMs struggle to reproduce.
sentences.zh: 先前的工作将此差距归因于一小组注意力头，称为聚集-聚合（Gather-and-Aggregate，G&A），SSM 难以重现它们。

sentences.en: We propose *retrieval-aware distillation*, which converts a pretrained Transformer into a hybrid student by preserving only these retrieval-critical heads and distilling the rest into recurrent heads.
sentences.zh: 我们提出*检索感知蒸馏*，它将预训练 Transformer 转换为混合学生模型，仅保留这些检索关键的注意力头，并把其余部分蒸馏进递归头。

sentences.en: We identify the essential heads via ablation on a synthetic retrieval task, producing a hybrid with sparse, non-uniform attention placement.
sentences.zh: 我们通过在一个合成检索任务上进行消融来识别必要头，产生具有稀疏、非均匀注意力放置的混合模型。

sentences.en: We show that preserving **just 2% of attention heads recovers over 95% of teacher performance on retrieval-heavy tasks** (10 heads in a 1B model), requiring far fewer heads than hybrids that retain at least 25%.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，**仅保留 2% 的注意力头即可在检索密集的任务上恢复教师模型 95% 以上的性能**（在 1B 模型中约为 10 个头），其所需的头数远少于至少保留 25% 头的混合模型。

sentences.en: We further find that large recurrent states often compensate for missing retrieval: once retrieval is handled by these heads, the SSM backbone can be simplified with limited loss, even with an 8× reduction in state dimension.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步发现，大的递归状态往往补偿缺失的检索能力：一旦检索由这些头处理，SSM 骨干可以在有限损失下被简化，即使状态维度缩减 8 倍。

sentences.en: By reducing both the attention cache and the SSM state, the resulting hybrid is 5–6× more memory-efficient than comparable hybrids, closing the Transformer–SSM gap at a fraction of the memory cost.
sentences.zh: 通过同时减小注意力缓存与 SSM 状态，所得的混合模型比可比较的混合模型内存效率高 5–6 倍，以一小部分内存成本弥合了 Transformer 与 SSM 之间的差距。

title_en: Retriever Portfolios: A Principled Approach to Adaptive RAG
title_zh: 检索器组合：自适应 RAG 的一种有原则的方法

sentences.en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems typically rely on a single retriever and a single set of hyperparameters, despite facing highly heterogeneous queries that range from simple factoid questions to complex multi-hop reasoning.
sentences.zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）系统通常依赖单一的检索器与单一组超参数，尽管它们面对的是高度异构的查询，从简单的事实型问题到复杂的多跳推理。

sentences.en: We propose a method that automatically selects a small,  diverse subset of retrievers (a portfolio) from a large pool of candidates, to cover  different regions of the target query distribution.
sentences.zh: 我们提出一种方法，从大量候选中自动选择一小批多样化的检索器（一个组合），以覆盖目标查询分布的不同区域。

sentences.en: We formalize this setting via an expected best-of-$k$ objective over  the query distribution and show that it admits an efficient portfolio construction  algorithm with near-optimal guarantees.
sentences.zh: 我们通过查询分布上的期望 best-of-$k$ 目标将该设定形式化，并表明它可以接受一个具有接近最优保证的高效组合构建算法。

sentences.en: Across multiple QA benchmarks, our learned portfolios and router pipeline consistently outperform single-retriever and naive multi-retriever baselines on both retrieval metrics and answer quality.
sentences.zh: 在多个 QA 基准上，我们学到的组合与路由器流水线在检索指标与答案质量两方面都一致地优于单检索器与朴素多检索器基线。

sentences.en: In addition, compared to inference-time hyperparameter tuning approaches, fixed portfolios  enable parallel retrieval and LLM calls, achieving comparable (and sometimes better) accuracy  with substantially lower latency and token cost.
sentences.zh: 此外，与推理时的超参数调优方法相比，固定组合支持并行的检索与 LLM 调用，以显著更低的延迟与词元成本实现了相当（有时更好）的准确率。

title_en: Retro-Expert: Collaborative Reasoning for Interpretable Retrosynthesis
title_zh: Retro-Expert：面向可解释逆合成的协作推理

sentences.en: Retrosynthesis prediction aims to infer the reactant molecules based on a given product molecule, which is a fundamental task in chemical synthesis.
sentences.zh: 逆合成预测旨在基于给定的产物分子推断反应物分子，这是化学合成中的一项基本任务。

sentences.en: However, existing methods rely on a static pattern-matching paradigm, which limits their ability to perform effective logical decision-making from chemical data, leading to a black-box process.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有方法依赖静态的模式匹配范式，这限制了它们从化学数据中进行有效逻辑决策的能力，导致黑盒过程。

sentences.en: We propose Retro-Expert, an interpretable retrosynthesis framework that performs collaborative reasoning by combining the complementary strengths of Large Language Models and specialized models via pure reinforcement learning.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 Retro-Expert，一个可解释的逆合成框架，它通过纯强化学习结合大语言模型与专门模型的互补优势，进行协作推理。

sentences.en: It outputs natural language explanations grounded in chemical logic through three components: (1) specialized models provide chemical knowledge that is distilled into a high-quality chemical decision space, (2) LLM-driven critical reasoning to generate predictions with an interpretable reasoning path, and (3) knowledge-grounded policy optimization refines the interpretable decision policy.
sentences.zh: 它通过三个组件输出植根于化学逻辑的自然语言解释：（1）专门模型提供化学知识，将其蒸馏为高质量的化学决策空间；（2）由 LLM 驱动的批判性推理，以带可解释推理路径的方式生成预测；（3）知识锚定的策略优化，以精炼可解释的决策策略。

sentences.en: Experiments show that Retro-Expert surpasses both LLM-based and specialized models across different metrics, while generating chemically grounded explanations that enhance chemists' trust in practice.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，Retro-Expert 在不同指标上超越了基于 LLM 与专门的模型，同时生成有化学依据的解释，提升了化学家在实践中的信任。

sentences.en: The source code for this paper is available at https://github.com/MagixRab-ll/Retro-Expert
sentences.zh: 本文的源代码可在 https://github.com/MagixRab-ll/Retro-Expert 获取。

title_en: RetrOrchestrator: A Multi-Step Retrosynthesis Agent Dynamically Orchestrating Single-Step Transition Models
title_zh: RetrOrchestrator：动态编排单步转移模型的多步逆合成智能体

sentences.en: Multi-step retrosynthesis planning is a fundamental challenge in organic chemistry, defined by its enormous search space.
sentences.zh: 多步逆合成规划是有机化学中的一个基本挑战，其特点是搜索空间巨大。

sentences.en: Existing methods typically formulate it as a Markov Decision Process (MDP) with a fixed choice of transition model (i.e., a single-step retrosynthesis model), and focus on improving *how to search* through better policies and value functions.
sentences.zh: 现有方法通常将其形式化为具有固定转移模型选择（即单步逆合成模型）的马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），并专注于通过更好的策略与价值函数来改进*如何搜索*。

sentences.en: However, *how the transition space itself is navigated* remains largely unexplored.
sentences.zh: 然而，*转移空间本身如何被导航*在很大程度上仍未得到探索。

sentences.en: This limitation is particularly urgent given our observation of pronounced *skill disparity* among single-step prediction models: different models exhibit substantially different performance across molecule states.
sentences.zh: 考虑到我们观察到单步预测模型之间存在显著*技能差异*，这一局限尤为紧迫：不同模型在不同分子状态上表现出截然不同的性能。

sentences.en: Motivated by this observation, we introduce RetrOrchestrator, an LLM-powered agent that explicitly accounts for model skill disparity by reframing retrosynthesis planning as a Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP).
sentences.zh: 受这一观察的启发，我们引入 RetrOrchestrator，一个由 LLM 驱动的智能体，它通过将逆合成规划重构为部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）来显式地考虑模型技能差异。

sentences.en: By regarding each single-step prediction model as a tool, we further propose a scaffold-aware reinforcement learning algorithm to optimize navigation policy within the transition space.
sentences.zh: 通过将每个单步预测模型视为一个工具，我们进一步提出一个支架感知的强化学习算法，以优化转移空间内的导航策略。

sentences.en: As a result, RetrOrchestrator jointly searches which molecule to expand and which single-step model to apply for the molecule at the current step.
sentences.zh: 因此，RetrOrchestrator 联合搜索当前步骤中要扩展哪个分子，以及为该分子应用哪个单步模型。

sentences.en: Empirically, RetrOrchestrator significantly outperforms static baselines on the Retro*-190 benchmark, achieving a state-of-the-art 94.21% success rate (vs. 9.47% off-the-shelf LLM and 82.63\% non-LLM state-dependent router), with 92.49% of solved routes invoking two or more SSRs—evidence that the policy is not collapsing to a single specialist or a static router.
sentences.zh: 在实证上，RetrOrchestrator 在 Retro*-190 基准上显著优于静态基线，取得了最先进的 94.21% 成功率（对比现成 LLM 的 9.47% 与非 LLM 状态依赖路由器的 82.63\%），其中 92.49% 的已求解路线调用了两个或更多 SSR——这证明策略并未坍缩为一个单一专家或一个静态路由器。

sentences.en: The same gain persists on a larger out-of-distribution set (PDB-600), with RetrOrchestrator Pareto-optimal in both wall-clock time and model-query count.
sentences.zh: 同样的收益在更大的分布外集合（PDB-600）上仍然保持，RetrOrchestrator 在墙钟时间与模型查询次数两方面均达到帕累托最优。

sentences.en: Code: https://github.com/ScottLiao920/verl-retro-agent.
sentences.zh: 代码：https://github.com/ScottLiao920/verl-retro-agent。

topic: General Machine Learning->Transfer, Multitask and Meta-learning
title_en: Retrospective Feature Estimation for Continual Learning
title_zh: 面向持续学习的回溯特征估计

sentences.en: The intrinsic capability to continuously learn a changing data stream is a desideratum of deep neural networks (DNNs).
sentences.zh: 持续学习变化数据流的内在能力是深度神经网络（DNN）的一项期望特性。

sentences.en: However, current DNNs suffer from catastrophic forgetting, which interferes with remembering past knowledge.
sentences.zh: 然而，当前的 DNN 遭受灾难性遗忘之苦，这干扰了对过往知识的记忆。

sentences.en: To mitigate this issue, existing Continual Learning (CL) approaches often retain exemplars for replay, regularize learning, or allocate dedicated capacity for new tasks.
sentences.zh: 为缓解这一问题，现有的持续学习（CL）方法往往保留样本以进行回放、正则化学习，或为新任务分配专用容量。

sentences.en: This paper investigates an unexplored direction for CL called Retrospective Feature Estimation (RFE).
sentences.zh: 本文研究 CL 中一个未被探索的方向，称为回溯特征估计（Retrospective Feature Estimation，RFE）。

sentences.en: RFE learns to reverse feature changes by aligning the features from the current trained DNN backward to the feature space of the old task, where performing predictions is easier.
sentences.zh: RFE 学习逆转特征变化，将当前已训练 DNN 的特征向后对齐到旧任务的特征空间，在该空间中进行预测更容易。

sentences.en: This retrospective process utilizes a chain of small feature mapping networks called retrospector modules.
sentences.zh: 这一回溯过程利用一条由称为回溯器（retrospector）模块的小型特征映射网络组成的链。

sentences.en: Empirical experiments on several CL benchmarks, including CIFAR10, CIFAR100, and Tiny ImageNet, demonstrate the effectiveness and potential of this novel CL direction compared to existing representative CL methods, motivating further research into retrospective mechanisms as a principled alternative for mitigating catastrophic forgetting in CL.
sentences.zh: 在包括 CIFAR10、CIFAR100 与 Tiny ImageNet 在内的多个 CL 基准上的实证实验，相比现有代表性 CL 方法证明了这一新颖 CL 方向的有效性与潜力，激励将回溯机制作为缓解 CL 中灾难性遗忘的一种有原则替代方案的进一步研究。

sentences.en: Code is available at: https://github.com/mail-research/retrospective-feature-estimation.
sentences.zh: 代码可在：https://github.com/mail-research/retrospective-feature-estimation 获取。

topic: General Machine Learning->Transfer, Multitask and Meta-learning
title_en: Return of Frustratingly Easy Unsupervised Video Domain Adaptation
title_zh: 无监督视频域适应的回归：出奇地简单

sentences.en: Unsupervised video domain adaptation (UVDA) is a practical but under-explored problem.
sentences.zh: 无监督视频域适应（UVDA）是一个实用但尚未充分探索的问题。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose a frustratingly easy UVDA method, called \emph{MetaTrans}.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出一种出奇地简单的 UVDA 方法，称为 \emph{MetaTrans}。

sentences.en: Specifically, \emph{MetaTrans} adopts a concise learning objective that contains only two fundamental loss terms.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，\emph{MetaTrans} 采用一个简洁的学习目标，其中仅包含两个基本损失项。

sentences.en: Despite the simplicity of the learning objective, \emph{MetaTrans} embodies an advanced UVDA idea, that is, handling the spatial and temporal divergence of cross-domain videos separately, through a subtle model architecture design.
sentences.zh: 尽管学习目标简单，\emph{MetaTrans} 通过一种精巧的模型架构设计，体现了一个先进的 UVDA 思想，即分别处理跨域视频的空间与时序差异。

sentences.en: By implementing a temporal-static subtraction module, \emph{MetaTrans} effectively removes spatial and temporal divergence.
sentences.zh: 通过实现一个时间-静态相减模块，\emph{MetaTrans} 有效地消除了空间与时序差异。

sentences.en: Extensive empirical evaluations, particularly on various cross-domain action recognition tasks, show substantial absolute adaptation performance enhancement and significantly superior relative performance gain compared with state-of-the-art UVDA baselines.
sentences.zh: 广泛的实证评估，特别是在各种跨域动作识别任务上，显示了大幅的绝对适应性能提升，并且相比最先进的 UVDA 基线取得了显著更优的相对性能增益。

authors.name: Zhiqiang Xu
authors.institution: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology

title_en: Return-Aligned Decision Transformer
title_zh: 回报对齐的决策 Transformer

sentences.en: Traditional approaches in offline reinforcement learning aim to learn the optimal policy that maximizes the cumulative reward, also known as return.
sentences.zh: 离线强化学习中的传统方法旨在学习最大化累计奖励（也称为回报）的最优策略。

sentences.en: It is increasingly important to adjust the performance of AI agents to meet human requirements, for example, in applications like video games and education tools.
sentences.zh: 调整 AI 智能体的性能以满足人类需求正变得越来越重要，例如在视频游戏与教育工具等应用中。

sentences.en: Decision Transformer (DT) optimizes a policy that generates actions conditioned on the target return through supervised learning and includes a mechanism to control the agent's performance using the target return.
sentences.zh: 决策 Transformer（DT）通过监督学习优化一个以目标回报为条件生成动作的策略，并包含一个利用目标回报来控制智能体性能的机制。

sentences.en: However, the action generation is hardly influenced by the target return because DT’s self-attention allocates scarce attention scores to the return tokens.
sentences.zh: 然而，动作生成几乎不受目标回报影响，因为 DT 的自注意力仅将稀缺的注意力分数分配给了回报词元。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose Return-Aligned Decision Transformer (RADT), designed to more effectively align the actual return with the target return.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出回报对齐的决策 Transformer（Return-Aligned Decision Transformer，RADT），旨在更有效地将实际回报与目标回报对齐。

sentences.en: RADT leverages features extracted by paying attention solely to the return, enabling action generation to consistently depend on the target return.
sentences.zh: RADT 利用仅对回报进行关注所提取的特征，使动作生成能够一致地依赖于目标回报。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments show that RADT significantly reduces the discrepancies between the actual return and the target return compared to DT-based methods.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，与基于 DT 的方法相比，RADT 显著减少了实际回报与目标回报之间的差异。

title_en: Return-Critic: Bridging Goal Discrepancy for Efficient Visual Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: Return-Critic：弥合目标差异以实现高效的视觉强化学习

sentences.en: Sample inefficiency remains a challenge in pixel-based visual reinforcement learning (RL), primarily due to ineffective state representation learning.
sentences.zh: 样本低效率仍是基于像素的视觉强化学习（RL）中的一项挑战，这主要归因于无效的状态表示学习。

sentences.en: While recent advances employ auxiliary tasks to improve representation learning, their representation goals (e.g., mask reconstruction, state prediction) are misaligned with the ultimate RL goal of maximizing return, constraining further improvements in representation quality.
sentences.zh: 虽然近期的进展采用辅助任务来改进表示学习，但它们的表示目标（例如掩码重建、状态预测）与最大化回报这一最终的 RL 目标并不对齐，从而限制了表示质量的进一步提升。

sentences.en: To achieve efficient visual reinforcement learning, we propose Return-Critic (RC), an auxiliary framework that bridges goal discrepancy by return prediction.
sentences.zh: 为实现高效的视觉强化学习，我们提出回报评论家（Return-Critic，RC），一个通过回报预测来弥合目标差异的辅助框架。

sentences.en: RC samples partial frames from an episode, processes them through a shared visual encoder, and employs a lightweight Transformer to predict the episode's return, forcing the encoder to learn return-relevant representation.
sentences.zh: RC 从一次情节中采样部分帧，通过一个共享的视觉编码器处理它们，并采用一个轻量级 Transformer 来预测该情节的回报，迫使编码器学习与回报相关的表示。

sentences.en: The attention weights naturally highlight important frames, enabling a key function for prioritized learning.
sentences.zh: 注意力权重自然地突出重要帧，从而实现了优先学习这一关键功能。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on both online (DMControl) and offline (V-D4RL) benchmarks demonstrate that RC significantly enhances the sample efficiency, particularly achieving 68% performance boost on average across nine challenging tasks from DMControl.
sentences.zh: 在在线（DMControl）与离线（V-D4RL）基准上的大量实验表明，RC 显著提升了样本效率，特别是在 DMControl 的九个挑战性任务上平均实现了 68% 的性能提升。

title_en: Return-to-Go Is More Than a Number: Q-Guided Alignment for Return-Conditioned Supervised Learning
title_zh: Return-to-Go 不仅仅是一个数字：面向回报条件化监督学习的 Q 引导对齐

sentences.en: Conditioned Sequence Models (CSMs) learn policies by treating return-to-go (RTG) as a control signal.
sentences.zh: 条件化序列模型（CSM）通过将回报-到-目标（RTG）作为控制信号来学习策略。

sentences.en: However, existing CSMs often treat the RTGs as simple numerical inputs rather than aligning them with the performance of their policies.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有的 CSM 往往将 RTG 视为简单的数值输入，而不会将这些输入与其策略的实际性能对齐。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose Q-ALIGN DT, a framework that enforces this alignment by ensuring the $Q$-value of the output policy is consistent with the input RTG.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出 Q-ALIGN DT，一个通过确保输出策略的 $Q$ 值与输入 RTG 一致来强制这种对齐的框架。

sentences.en: By leveraging a $Q$ function to provide dense guidance to CSMs and further fine-tuning it using an *RTG-perturbation* technique with the CSM, our method ensures that higher RTGs are consistently mapped to trajectories with higher expected returns.
sentences.zh: 通过利用一个 $Q$ 函数向 CSM 提供稠密引导，并进一步使用一种 *RTG 扰动* 技术与 CSM 一起对该函数进行微调，我们的方法确保更高的 RTG 一致地映射到具有更高期望回报的轨迹上。

sentences.en: Theoretically, we show that Q-ALIGN DT can efficiently learn the desired policy and output a near-optimal one when the RTG is sufficiently high.
sentences.zh: 在理论上，我们表明，当 RTG 足够高时，Q-ALIGN DT 能够高效地学习期望的策略并输出一个接近最优的策略。

sentences.en: Empirically, we demonstrate through extensive experiments that Q-ALIGN DT achieves superior controllability and performance across the D4RL benchmark.
sentences.zh: 在实证上，我们通过大量实验证明 Q-ALIGN DT 在 D4RL 基准上实现了优越的可控性与性能。

sentences.en: Remarkably, our model effectively learns a structured family of policies that maintains precise alignment and generalizes to tasks like velocity-tracking where prior methods fail.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，我们的模型有效地学习了一个结构化的策略族，它保持了精确的对齐，并泛化到诸如速度跟踪之类的先前方法失效的任务上。

title_en: Reuse your FLOPs: Scaling RL on Hard Problems by Conditioning on Very Off-Policy Prefixes
title_zh: 复用你的 FLOPs：通过条件化于高度离策略的前缀在难题上扩展 RL

sentences.en: Typical reinforcement learning (RL) methods for LLM reasoning waste compute on hard problems, where correct on-policy traces are rare and policy gradients vanish.
sentences.zh: 用于 LLM 推理的典型强化学习（RL）方法在难题上浪费计算，因为在策略的正确轨迹很稀缺，且策略梯度会消失。

sentences.en: To bootstrap more efficient RL, we consider reusing old sampling FLOPs (from prior inference or RL training) in the form of off-policy traces.
sentences.zh: 为引导更高效的 RL，我们考虑以离策略轨迹的形式复用旧的采样 FLOPs（来自先前的推理或 RL 训练）。

sentences.en: We introduce PrefixRL, where we condition on the prefix of successful off-policy traces and run on-policy RL to complete them, side-stepping instabilities from using off-policy data as supervision targets.
sentences.zh: 我们引入 PrefixRL，它条件化在成功离策略轨迹的前缀上，并运行在策略 RL 来完成它们，从而规避了将离策略数据用作监督目标所带来的不稳定性。

sentences.en: PrefixRL boosts the learning signal on hard problems by modulating the difficulty of the problem through the off-policy prefix length.
sentences.zh: PrefixRL 通过离策略前缀长度来调节问题难度，从而在难题上增强了学习信号。

sentences.en: We prove that the PrefixRL objective is not only consistent with the standard RL objective but also more sample efficient.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，PrefixRL 目标不仅与标准 RL 目标一致，而且更具样本效率。

sentences.en: Empirically, we discover back-generalization:  training only on prefixed problems generalizes to out-of-distribution unprefixed performance, with learned strategies often differing from those in the prefix.
sentences.zh: 在实证上，我们发现反向泛化：仅在加前缀的问题上训练会泛化到分布外的无前缀性能，且学到的策略往往与前缀中的策略不同。

sentences.en: In our experiments, we source the off-policy traces by rejection sampling with the base model, creating a self-improvement loop.
sentences.zh: 在我们的实验中，我们通过使用基础模型的拒绝采样获得离策略轨迹，形成一个自我改进循环。

sentences.en: On hard reasoning problems, PrefixRL reaches the same training reward 2x faster than the strongest baseline (SFT on off-policy data then RL), even after accounting for the compute spent on the initial rejection sampling, and increases the final reward by 3x.
sentences.zh: 在困难的推理问题上，即使计入了初始拒绝采样的计算开销，PrefixRL 达到相同训练奖励的速度仍比最强基线（先对离策略数据做 SFT 再 RL）快 2 倍，并将最终奖励提升了 3 倍。

title_en: Reusing Trajectories in Policy Gradients Enables Fast Convergence
title_zh: 在策略梯度中复用轨迹可实现快速收敛

sentences.en: *Policy gradient* (PG) methods are a class of effective *reinforcement learning* algorithms, particularly when dealing with continuous control problems.
sentences.zh: *策略梯度*（PG）方法是一类有效的*强化学习*算法，尤其是在处理连续控制问题时。

sentences.en: They rely on fresh *on-policy* data, making them sample-inefficient and requiring $\mathcal{O}(\epsilon^{-2})$ trajectories to reach an $\epsilon$-approximate stationary point.
sentences.zh: 它们依赖新鲜的*在策略*数据，这使得它们样本低效，并需要 $\mathcal{O}(\epsilon^{-2})$ 条轨迹才能达到一个 $\epsilon$-近似的驻点。

sentences.en: A common strategy to improve efficiency is to *reuse* information from past iterations, such as previous *gradients* or *trajectories*, leading to *off-policy* PG methods.
sentences.zh: 一种常见的提升效率的策略是从过去的迭代中*复用*信息，例如先前的*梯度*或*轨迹*，从而产生*离策略*的 PG 方法。

sentences.en: While gradient reuse has received substantial attention, leading to improved rates up to $\mathcal{O}(\epsilon^{-3/2})$, the reuse of past trajectories, although intuitive, remains largely unexplored from a theoretical perspective.
sentences.zh: 虽然梯度复用已受到大量关注，带来了高达 $\mathcal{O}(\epsilon^{-3/2})$ 的改进速率，但过去轨迹的复用虽然直观，却从理论视角来看仍在很大程度上未被探索。

sentences.en: In this work, we provide the first rigorous theoretical evidence that reusing past off-policy trajectories can significantly accelerate PG convergence.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们提供了首个严谨的理论证据，表明复用过去的离策略轨迹可以显著加速 PG 收敛。

sentences.en: We propose RT-PG (Reusing Trajectories - Policy Gradient), a novel algorithm that leverages a *power mean*-corrected multiple importance weighting estimator to effectively combine on-policy and off-policy data coming from the most recent $\omega$ iterations.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 RT-PG（复用轨迹-策略梯度），一种新颖算法，它利用*幂均值*校正的多重重要性加权估计器，来有效组合来自最近 $\omega$ 次迭代的在策略与离策略数据。

sentences.en: Through a novel analysis, we prove that RT-PG achieves a sample complexity of $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\epsilon^{-2}\omega^{-1})$.
sentences.zh: 通过一项新颖的分析，我们证明 RT-PG 达到了 $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\epsilon^{-2}\omega^{-1})$ 的样本复杂度。

sentences.en: When reusing *all* available past trajectories, this leads to a rate of $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\epsilon^{-1})$, the best known  one in the literature for PG methods.
sentences.zh: 当复用*所有*可用的过去轨迹时，这导致一个 $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\epsilon^{-1})$ 的速率，这是文献中 PG 方法已知最好的速率。

sentences.en: We further validate our approach empirically, demonstrating its effectiveness against baselines with state-of-the-art rates.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步在实证上验证了我们的方法，展示了其相对具有最先进速率基线的有效性。

title_en: Revealing Behavioral Plasticity in Large Language Models: A Token-Conditional Perspective
title_zh: 揭示大语言模型中的行为可塑性：一种词元条件化视角

sentences.en: In this work, we reveal that Large Language Models (LLMs) possess intrinsic behavioral plasticity—akin to chameleons adapting their coloration to environmental cues—that can be *exposed* through token-conditional generation and *stabilized* via reinforcement learning.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们揭示大语言模型（LLM）具有内在的行为可塑性——类似于变色龙根据环境线索调整体色——这种可塑性可以通过词元条件化生成来*暴露*，并可通过强化学习*稳定*。

sentences.en: Specifically, by conditioning generation on carefully selected token prefixes sampled from responses exhibiting desired behaviors, LLMs seamlessly adapt their behavioral modes at inference time (e.g., switching from step-by-step reasoning to direct answering) without retraining.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，通过将生成条件化于从表现出期望行为的响应中采样得到的、经过精心选择的词元前缀，LLM 在推理时无缝地调整其行为模式（例如，从逐步推理切换到直接回答），而无需重新训练。

sentences.en: Based on this insight, we propose **To**ken-**Co**nditioned **R**einforcement **L**earning (**ToCoRL**), a principled framework that leverages RL to internalize this chameleon-like plasticity, transforming transient inference-time adaptations into stable and learnable behavioral patterns.
sentences.zh: 基于这一洞见，我们提出 **To**ken-**Co**nditioned **R**einforcement **L**earning（**ToCoRL**，词元条件化强化学习），一个有原则的框架，它利用 RL 将这种变色龙般的可塑性内化，把瞬时的推理时适应转化为稳定且可学习的行为模式。

sentences.en: ToCoRL guides exploration with token-conditional generation and keep enhancing exploitation, enabling emergence of appropriate behaviors.
sentences.zh: ToCoRL 用词元条件化生成引导探索，并持续推进利用，从而实现适当行为的出现。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments show that ToCoRL enables precise behavioral control without capability degradation.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，ToCoRL 在不降低能力的前提下实现了精确的行为控制。

sentences.en: Notably, we show that large reasoning models, while performing strongly on complex mathematics, can be effectively adapted to excel at factual question answering, which was a capability previously hindered by their step-by-step reasoning patterns.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，我们表明，大型推理模型虽然在复杂数学上表现出色，但可以被有效地适配为擅长事实性问答，而这一能力此前被其逐步推理模式所阻碍。

title_en: Revealing Long-context Potential of Attention Heads via Frequency Kernels
title_zh: 通过频率核揭示注意力头的长上下文潜力

sentences.en: Large language model (LLM) exists a subset of attention heads that are highly responsible for long-context processing.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）中存在一小组高度负责长上下文处理的注意力头。

sentences.en: Existing work has identified different long-context heads in models, but their detection methods mainly rely on model inference on actual long texts and do not analyze the inherent properties of the head parameters.
sentences.zh: 现有工作已识别出模型中的不同长上下文头，但它们的检测方法主要依赖在真实长文本上的模型推理，并不分析头参数的内在属性。

sentences.en: In this paper, we use kernel methods to analyze static \textit{frequency kernels} formed by different rotation frequency components of attention heads, and we design a Long-context Potential Score (LPS) to measure the potential of attention heads in processing long contexts.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们使用核方法分析由注意力头的不同旋转频率分量形成的静态 \textit{frequency kernels}（频率核），并设计一个长上下文潜力分数（Long-context Potential Score，LPS）来衡量注意力头在处理长上下文方面的潜力。

sentences.en: Kernels of heads with high LPS exhibit concentrated low-frequency energy and low effective rank, which allow them to effectively capture highly specialized information from distant contexts.
sentences.zh: 具有高 LPS 的头的核表现出集中的低频能量与低有效秩，这使得它们能够有效捕获来自遥远上下文的高度专门化的信息。

sentences.en: Experiments and analysis on long-context tasks and model behaviors show that the LPS metrics can well reflect the actual capability of heads on long contexts.
sentences.zh: 在长上下文任务与模型行为上的实验与分析表明，LPS 指标能够很好地反映头在长上下文上的实际能力。

sentences.en: Furthermore, by simply amplifying low-frequency kernels of heads with high retrieval potential, we can further improve model's performance on long-context tasks.
sentences.zh: 此外，通过简单地放大具有高检索潜力的头的低频核，我们可以进一步提升模型在长上下文任务上的性能。

sentences.en: Our metrics and head enhancement methods are fully static and offline, and they can be quickly conducted under low-resource constraints.
sentences.zh: 我们的指标与头增强方法完全是静态与离线的，它们可以在低资源约束下快速实施。

sentences.en: Code is publicly available at [here](https://github.com/OpenDFM/long-context-heads).
sentences.zh: 代码可在 [此处](https://github.com/OpenDFM/long-context-heads) 公开获取。

title_en: Revealing Scaling Paradox in Large-scale Time Series Models: Implications for More Efficient and Accurate Forecasting
title_zh: 揭示大规模时间序列模型中的缩放悖论：对更高效与更准确预测的启示

sentences.en: Large-scale models are at the forefront of time series (TS) forecasting, dominated by two paradigms: fine-tuning text-based Large Language Models for TS (LLM4TS) and training Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) from scratch.
sentences.zh: 大规模模型正处于时间序列（TS）预测的最前沿，由两种范式主导：微调基于文本的大语言模型用于 TS（LLM4TS），以及从头训练时间序列基础模型（TSFM）。

sentences.en: Both approaches share a foundational assumption that scaling up model capacity and data volume leads to improved performance.
sentences.zh: 这两种方法都共享一个基本假设：扩展模型容量与数据量会带来性能提升。

sentences.en: However, we observe a scaling paradox in TS models, revealing a puzzling phenomenon that larger models do NOT always achieve better performance.
sentences.zh: 然而，我们观察到 TS 模型中存在一种缩放悖论，揭示了一个令人费解的现象：更大的模型并不总是取得更好的性能。

sentences.en: Through extensive experiments on two model families across four scales (100M to 1.7B parameters) and diverse data (up to 6B observations), we rigorously confirm that the scaling paradox is a pervasive issue.
sentences.zh: 通过在两个模型家族、四种规模（1 亿到 17 亿参数）以及多样数据（多达 60 亿观测）上进行的大量实验，我们严格证实缩放悖论是一个普遍存在的问题。

sentences.en: We then diagnose its root cause by analyzing internal representations, identifying a phenomenon we call few-layer dominance: only a small subset of layers are functionally important, while the majority are redundant, under-utilized, and can even distract training.
sentences.zh: 随后，我们通过分析内部表示来诊断其根本原因，识别出我们称之为少数层主导的现象：只有一小部分层在功能上重要，而大多数层是冗余的、未被充分利用的，甚至可能干扰训练。

sentences.en: Based on this discovery, we propose a practical method to automatically identify and retain only these dominant layers.
sentences.zh: 基于这一发现，我们提出一种实用方法，自动识别并仅保留这些主导层。

sentences.en: In our models, retaining only 21% of the parameters achieves up to a 12% accuracy improvement and a 2.7x inference speedup.
sentences.zh: 在我们的模型中，仅保留 21% 的参数即可实现高达 12% 的准确率提升与 2.7x 的推理加速。

sentences.en: We validate the universality of our method on 8 prominent SOTA models (LLM4TS and TSFMs, 90M to 6B), showing that retaining less than 30% layers achieves superior accuracy in over 95% tasks.
sentences.zh: 我们在 8 个著名的 SOTA 模型（LLM4TS 与 TSFM，90M 到 6B）上验证了我们方法的普适性，表明保留不到 30% 的层即可在超过 95% 的任务上取得优越的准确率。

title_en: RevealLayer: Disentangling Hidden and Visible Layers via Occlusion-Aware Image Decomposition
title_zh: RevealLayer：通过遮挡感知的图像分解解纠缠隐藏与可见图层

sentences.en: Recent diffusion-based approaches have made substantial progress in image layer decomposition.
sentences.zh: 近期的基于扩散的方法在图像图层分解方面取得了实质性进展。

sentences.en: However, accurately decomposing complex natural images remains challenging due to difficulties in occlusion completion, robust layer disentanglement, and precise foreground boundaries.
sentences.zh: 然而，由于遮挡补全、稳健的图层解纠缠与精确前景边界的困难，准确分解复杂自然图像仍具挑战性。

sentences.en: Moreover, the scarcity of high-quality multi-layer natural image datasets limits advancement.
sentences.zh: 此外，高质量多层自然图像数据集的稀缺限制了进展。

sentences.en: To address these challenges, we propose **RevealLayer**, a diffusion-based framework that decomposes an RGB image into multiple RGBA layers, enabling precise layer separation and reliable recovery of occluded content in natural images.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出 **RevealLayer**，一个基于扩散的框架，它将一张 RGB 图像分解为多个 RGBA 图层，实现精确的图层分离与自然图像中被遮挡内容的可靠恢复。

sentences.en: RevealLayer incorporates three key components: (1) a **Region-Aware Attention** module to disentangle hidden and visible layers; (2) an **Occlusion-Guided Adapter** to leverage contextual information to enhance overlapping regions; and (3) a **composite loss** to enforce sharp alpha boundaries and suppress residual artifacts.
sentences.zh: RevealLayer 包含三个关键组件：（1）一个 **区域感知注意力**（Region-Aware Attention）模块，用于解纠缠隐藏与可见图层；（2）一个 **遮挡引导适配器**（Occlusion-Guided Adapter），利用上下文信息增强重叠区域；以及（3）一个 **复合损失**（composite loss），用于强化锐利的 alpha 边界并抑制残余伪影。

sentences.en: To support training and evaluation, we introduce **RevealLayer-100K**, a high-quality multi-layer natural image constructed through a collaboration between automated algorithms and human annotation, and further establish **RevealLayerBench** for benchmarking layer decomposition in general natural scenes.
sentences.zh: 为支持训练与评估，我们引入 **RevealLayer-100K**，一个通过自动算法与人工标注协作构建的高质量多层自然图像集，并进一步建立 **RevealLayerBench**，用于在一般自然场景中基准测试图层分解。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that RevealLayer consistently outperforms existing approaches in layer decomposition.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，RevealLayer 在图层分解方面一致地优于现有方法。

title_en: Revenue Efficiency of Correlated Equilibria in First Price Auctions
title_zh: 首价拍卖中相关均衡的收益效率

sentences.en: We study the revenue of approximate correlated equilibrium in discrete first price auctions - the set of allowable bids is $\mathcal{B} = \{0, 1/k, \dots, 1 - 1/k, 1\}$ for some $k \in \mathbb{N}$.
sentences.zh: 我们研究离散首价拍卖中近似相关均衡的收益——允许的出价集合是 $\mathcal{B} = \{0, 1/k, \dots, 1 - 1/k, 1\}$，其中对于某个 $k \in \mathbb{N}$。

sentences.en: We show that the revenue of any $\epsilon$-\textit{approximate} correlated equilibrium is at least $v_2 -  \Theta(1/k)- \Theta(\epsilon k^2)$, where $v_2 \geq 0$ is the second-highest valuation.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，任何 $\epsilon$-\textit{近似}相关均衡的收益至少为 $v_2 -  \Theta(1/k)- \Theta(\epsilon k^2)$，其中 $v_2 \geq 0$ 是第二高估值。

sentences.en: Our results establish the first polynomial convergence rates on the revenue generated by no-swap regret bidders in first-price auctions.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果为无交换遗憾竞拍者在首价拍卖中产生的收益建立了首个多项式收敛速率。

sentences.en: For instance, if bidders admit the optimal swap regret of $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{k T})$, then the time-averaged revenue is at least $v_2 -  \Theta(1/k) -  \Theta(\epsilon)$ after $\mathcal{O}(k^5/\epsilon^2)$ rounds.
sentences.zh: 例如，如果竞拍者承认最优交换遗憾为 $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{k T})$，那么在 $\mathcal{O}(k^5/\epsilon^2)$ 轮之后，时间平均收益至少为 $v_2 -  \Theta(1/k) -  \Theta(\epsilon)$。

title_en: Revenue Guarantees of No-Swap-Regret Dynamics in First Price Auctions

title_en: Reverse Flow Matching: A Unified Framework for Online Reinforcement Learning with Diffusion and Flow Policies
title_zh: 反向流匹配：面向带扩散与流策略的在线强化学习的统一框架

sentences.en: Diffusion and flow policies are gaining prominence in online reinforcement learning (RL) due to their expressive power, yet training them efficiently remains a critical challenge.
sentences.zh: 扩散与流策略凭借其强大的表达能力正在在线强化学习（RL）中日益受到重视，然而高效地训练它们仍是一个关键挑战。

sentences.en: A fundamental difficulty that distinguishes online RL from standard generative modeling is the lack of direct samples from the target Boltzmann distribution defined by the Q-function.
sentences.zh: 将在线 RL 与标准生成建模区分开来的一项根本困难是：缺乏来自由 Q 函数定义的目标 Boltzmann 分布的直接样本。

sentences.en: To address this, two seemingly distinct families of methods have been proposed for diffusion policies: a noise-expectation family, which uses a weighted average of noise as the training target, and a gradient-expectation family, which employs a weighted average of Q-function gradients.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一点，针对扩散策略提出了两个看似不同的方法族：噪声期望族，它使用噪声的加权平均作为训练目标；以及梯度期望族，它采用 Q 函数梯度的加权平均。

sentences.en: However, it remains unclear how these objectives are formally related, or whether they can be synthesized into a more general formulation.
sentences.zh: 然而，这些目标在形式上如何关联，以及它们能否被综合为更一般的表述，仍不清楚。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose a unified framework, reverse flow matching (RFM), which rigorously addresses the problem of training diffusion and flow models without direct target samples.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出一个统一框架，即反向流匹配（reverse flow matching，RFM），它严谨地解决了在没有直接目标样本的情况下训练扩散与流模型的问题。

sentences.en: By adopting a reverse inferential perspective, we formulate the training target as a posterior mean estimation problem given an intermediate noisy sample.
sentences.zh: 通过采用反向推断视角，我们将训练目标形式化为给定一个中间带噪样本的后验均值估计问题。

sentences.en: Crucially, we introduce Langevin Stein operators to construct zero-mean control variates, deriving a general class of estimators that share the same expectation.
sentences.zh: 关键的是，我们引入 Langevin Stein 算子来构造零均值控制变量，推导出共享相同期望的一类通用估计器。

sentences.en: We show that existing noise-expectation and gradient-expectation methods are simply two specific instances within this broader class.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，现有的噪声期望与梯度期望方法只是这一更广泛类别中的两个特定实例。

sentences.en: This unified view yields two key advancements: it extends the capability of targeting Boltzmann distributions from diffusion to flow policies, and it enables the principled combination of Q-value and Q-gradient information to form an effective estimator, thereby improving training efficiency and stability.
sentences.zh: 这一统一视角带来了两项关键进展：它将对准 Boltzmann 分布的能力从扩散策略扩展到流策略，并使 Q 值与 Q 梯度信息的有机结合以形成有效估计器成为可能，从而提升了训练效率与稳定性。

sentences.en: We instantiate RFM to train a flow policy in online RL and demonstrate improved performance on continuous-control benchmarks compared to diffusion policy baselines.
sentences.zh: 我们实例化 RFM 在在线 RL 中训练一个流策略，并在连续控制基准上展示了相比扩散策略基线更优越的性能。

title_en: Reverse-Engineering Model Editing on Language Models
title_zh: 对语言模型的模型编辑进行逆向工程

sentences.en: Large language models (LLMs) are pretrained on corpora containing trillions of tokens and, therefore, inevitably memorize sensitive information.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）在包含数万亿词元的语料库上预训练，因此不可避免地会记忆敏感信息。

sentences.en: Locate-then-edit methods, as a mainstream paradigm of model editing, offer a promising solution by modifying model parameters without retraining.
sentences.zh: 定位后编辑（locate-then-edit）方法作为模型编辑的主流范式，通过修改模型参数而无需重新训练，提供了一种有前景的解决方案。

sentences.en: However, in this work, we reveal a critical vulnerability of this paradigm: the parameter updates inadvertently serve as a side channel, enabling attackers to recover the edited data.
sentences.zh: 然而，在本工作中，我们揭示这一范式的关键漏洞：参数更新无意中充当了侧信道，使攻击者能够恢复被编辑的数据。

sentences.en: We propose a two-stage reverse-engineering attack named KSTER (KeySpaceReconsTruction-then-EntropyReduction) that leverages the low-rank structure of these updates.
sentences.zh: 我们提出一种两阶段逆向工程攻击，名为 KSTER（键空间重构后熵缩减，KeySpaceReconsTruction-then-EntropyReduction），它利用这些更新的低秩结构。

sentences.en: First, we theoretically show that the row space of the update matrix encodes a "fingerprint" of the edited subjects, enabling accurate subject recovery via spectral analysis.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们在理论上证明，更新矩阵的行空间编码了被编辑主体的“指纹”，使得通过谱分析能够精确恢复主体。

sentences.en: Second, we introduce an entropy-based prompt recovery attack that reconstructs the semantic context of the edit.
sentences.zh: 其次，我们引入一种基于熵的提示恢复攻击，它重建编辑的语义上下文。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on multiple LLMs demonstrate that our attacks can recover edited data with high success rates.
sentences.zh: 在多个 LLM 上的大量实验表明，我们的攻击能够以高成功率恢复被编辑的数据。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we propose subspace camouflage, a defense strategy that obfuscates the update fingerprint with semantic decoys.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们提出子空间伪装（subspace camouflage），一种用语义诱饵混淆更新指纹的防御策略。

sentences.en: This approach effectively mitigates reconstruction risks without compromising editing utility.
sentences.zh: 这一方法有效缓解了重建风险，而不损害编辑效用。

sentences.en: Our code is available at https://github.com/reanatom/EditingAttack.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 https://github.com/reanatom/EditingAttack 获取。

authors.name: Yu Wang
authors.institution: Institute of Information Engineering, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Beijing, China

title_en: REVIS: Sparse Latent Steering to Mitigate Object Hallucination in Large Vision-Language Models
title_zh: REVIS：通过稀疏潜在引导缓解大型视觉—语言模型中的对象幻觉

sentences.en: Despite the advanced capabilities of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs), they frequently suffer from object hallucination.
sentences.zh: 尽管大型视觉—语言模型（LVLM）具有先进的能力，它们仍频繁遭受对象幻觉之苦。

sentences.en: One reason is that visual features and pretrained textual representations often become intertwined in the deeper network layers.
sentences.zh: 一个原因在于，视觉特征与预训练的文本表示往往在更深的网络层中相互纠缠。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose REVIS, a training-free framework designed to explicitly re-activate this suppressed visual information.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一点，我们提出 REVIS，一个免训练框架，旨在显式地重新激活这种被抑制的视觉信息。

sentences.en: Rooted in latent space geometry, REVIS extracts the pure visual information vector via orthogonal projection and employs a calibrated strategy to perform sparse intervention only at the precise depth where suppression occurs.
sentences.zh: 植根于潜在空间几何，REVIS 通过正交投影提取纯视觉信息向量，并采用一个经校准的策略，仅在出现抑制的精确深度处执行稀疏干预。

sentences.en: This surgical approach effectively restores visual information with minimal computational cost.
sentences.zh: 这种外科手术式的方法以极小的计算成本有效恢复了视觉信息。

sentences.en: Empirical evaluations on standard benchmarks demonstrate that REVIS reduces object hallucination rates by approximately 19% compared to state-of-the-art baselines, while preserving general reasoning capabilities.
sentences.zh: 在标准基准上的实证评估表明，相比最先进的基线，REVIS 将对象幻觉率降低了约 19%，同时保持了通用推理能力。

authors.institution: University of Science and Technology of China

title_en: Revisiting Anisotropy in Language Transformers: The Geometry of Learning Dynamics
title_zh: 重新审视语言 Transformer 中的各向异性：学习动力学的几何

sentences.en: Since their introduction, Transformer architectures have dominated Natural Language Processing (NLP).
sentences.zh: 自推出以来，Transformer 架构一直主导着自然语言处理（NLP）。

sentences.en: However, recent research has highlighted an inherent anisotropy phenomenon in these models, presenting a significant challenge to their geometric interpretation.
sentences.zh: 然而，近期研究凸显了这些模型中一种固有的各向异性现象，对其几何解释构成了重大挑战。

sentences.en: Previous theoretical studies on this phenomenon are rarely based on the underlying representation geometry.
sentences.zh: 先前关于这一现象的理论研究很少以底层的表示几何为基础。

sentences.en: In this paper, we extend them by providing such theoretical arguments assessing the problematic nature of this phenomenon.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们通过提供这种理论论证来扩展它们，评估这一现象的问题性。

sentences.en: Furthermore, to observe geometric internal model dynamics, we apply mechanistic interpretability (MI) techniques during the model's training checkpoints rather than post-hoc, as it is commonly done in the literature.
sentences.zh: 此外，为观察几何层面的内部模型动力学，我们在模型训练的检查点上应用机制可解释性（MI）技术，而非像文献中常见的那样事后应用。

sentences.en: By analyzing multiple models and their checkpoints -including EuroBERT, the Pythia suite, and SmolLM2- we investigate the structure of embedding representations and their correlation with the on manifold entropy of their underlying distribution.
sentences.zh: 通过分析多个模型及其检查点——包括 EuroBERT、Pythia 套件与 SmolLM2——我们研究了嵌入表示的结构，以及它们与其底层分布的流形上熵之间的相关性。

title_en: Revisiting Asymmetries in Black-box Link Stealing against Graph Neural Networks
title_zh: 重新审视针对图神经网络的黑盒链接窃取中的不对称性

sentences.en: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are increasingly deployed on sensitive relational data, from social networks to healthcare records.
sentences.zh: 图神经网络（GNN）越来越多地被部署到敏感的关系数据上，从社交网络到医疗记录。

sentences.en: However, their outputs can leak private graph structure, enabling link-stealing attacks that infer whether a connection between two entities existed in the training graph.
sentences.zh: 然而，它们的输出可能泄漏私有的图结构，使链接窃取攻击能够推断训练图中两个实体之间是否存在连接。

sentences.en: While prior work demonstrates high average performance for such attacks, privacy is fundamentally a worst-case property, not an average one.
sentences.zh: 虽然先前的工作证明了此类攻击具有较高的平均性能，但隐私从根本上是一种最坏情况属性，而非平均属性。

sentences.en: The key question is whether an adversary can reliably compromise even a small set of critical links under strict precision constraints.
sentences.zh: 关键问题是，对手能否在严格的精度约束下可靠地攻破哪怕一小部分关键链接。

sentences.en: We revisit posterior-only link-stealing attacks in a strict black-box setting and show that they remain effective at extremely low false-positive rates, revealing tail-risk vulnerabilities that current evaluations overlook.
sentences.zh: 我们重新审视严格黑盒设置中仅基于后验的链接窃取攻击，并表明它们在极低的假阳性率下仍然有效，揭示了当前评估所忽视的尾部风险漏洞。

sentences.en: We further find that intra-class vulnerabilities are suppressed by geometric bottlenecks that collapse discriminative directions in posterior space.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步发现，类内漏洞被几何瓶颈所压制，这些瓶颈使后验空间中的判别方向坍缩。

sentences.en: Building on this insight, we propose a geometry-aware reconditioning method that reshapes intra-class distances, substantially improving separability without harming reliability.
sentences.zh: 基于这一洞见，我们提出一种几何感知的再调节方法，它重塑类内距离，在无损可靠性的情况下大幅提升可分离性。

sentences.en: Across multiple real-world graphs and GNNs, this diagnostic correction achieves up to $2\times$ higher success on intra-class pairs than generic attacks, redefining link-privacy evaluation as a tail-risk problem and revealing that posterior leakage remains substantially under-measured in current GNN deployments.
sentences.zh: 在多个真实世界图与 GNN 上，这一诊断性修正相比通用攻击在类内对上取得了高达 $2\times$ 的成功率，将链接隐私评估重新定义为尾部风险问题，并揭示当前 GNN 部署中的后验泄漏仍被大幅低估。

title_en: Revisiting Coding-Based Approaches to Overcome the Curse of Dimensionality in Learning-Based Watermarking
title_zh: 重新审视基于编码的方法以克服学习式水印中的维度诅咒

sentences.en: Deep learning–based watermarking has substantially improved robustness to real-world noise, but its performance degrades as the payload dimension increases.
sentences.zh: 基于深度学习的水印已显著提升了对真实世界噪声的鲁棒性，但它的性能会随载荷维度的增加而下降。

sentences.en: In contrast, coding-based methods such as quantization index modulation (QIM) do not suffer from this curse of dimensionality, although they are less robust to real-world noise.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，诸如量化索引调制（QIM）之类的基于编码的方法并不遭受这种维度诅咒，尽管它们对真实世界噪声的鲁棒性较差。

sentences.en: To leverage the strengths of both approaches, we propose OrthoMark, a framework that decouples robust feature extraction from message encoding.
sentences.zh: 为发挥两种方法的优势，我们提出 OrthoMark，一个将稳健特征提取与消息编码解耦的框架。

sentences.en: OrthoMark first learns a distortion-invariant feature representation using a deep robust feature extractor, and then performs watermark encoding and decoding in this feature domain using coding-based methods.
sentences.zh: OrthoMark 首先使用一个深度稳健特征提取器学习失真不变的特征表示，然后在这一特征域中使用基于编码的方法执行水印编码与解码。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that OrthoMark significantly improves the trade-off among visual quality, robustness, and capacity compared to prior deep watermarking methods, with particularly large gains in the high capacity regime, effectively overcoming the curse of dimensionality.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，与先前的深度水印方法相比，OrthoMark 显著改善了视觉质量、鲁棒性与容量之间的权衡，尤其是在高容量场景下取得了很大提升，有效克服了维度诅咒。

sentences.en: Our code is available at \url{https://github.com/QQiuyp/OrthoMark}.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 \url{https://github.com/QQiuyp/OrthoMark} 获取。

authors.name: Han Fang
authors.institution: University of Science and Technology of China

title_en: Revisiting Distribution Correction Estimation for Offline Imitation Learning with Suboptimal Dataset
title_zh: 重新审视带次优数据集的离线模仿学习的分布修正估计

sentences.en: Imitation Learning (IL) learns high-quality policies from expert demonstrations but degrades in low-expert-data regimes.
sentences.zh: 模仿学习（IL）从专家演示中学习高质量策略，但在低专家数据场景下会退化。

sentences.en: To address this, recent work studies ``*offline IL with supplementary data*", augmenting expert data with trajectories from suboptimal policies.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一问题，近期工作研究“带补充数据的离线 IL”（offline IL with supplementary data），用来自次优策略的轨迹扩充专家数据。

sentences.en: A prominent framework is Distribution Correction Estimation (DICE), which estimates density ratios via the dual of a divergence minimization problem between learned and expert visitation distributions.
sentences.zh: 一个重要的框架是分布修正估计（DICE），它通过学习策略访问分布与专家访问分布之间散度最小化问题的对偶来估计密度比。

sentences.en: However, existing DICE-based methods either rely on a strict coverage assumption or introduce additional dataset regularization, limiting performance.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有的基于 DICE 的方法要么依赖严格的覆盖假设，要么引入额外的数据集正则化，从而限制了性能。

sentences.en: We propose **ReDICE**, a new DICE-based method that addresses these issues through an objective-level reformulation.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 **ReDICE**，一种新的基于 DICE 的方法，它通过目标层面的重新表述来解决这些问题。

sentences.en: Our approach constructs a mixture-distribution objective that preserves the original expert-imitation objective while removing the coverage assumption, and its dual reduces to a stable Gumbel regression objective for efficient optimization.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法构造一个混合分布目标，它在去除覆盖假设的同时保留原始的专家模仿目标，并且其对偶简化为一个稳定的 Gumbel 回归目标，从而实现高效优化。

sentences.en: We further introduce a novel policy extraction mechanism that improves performance.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步引入一种新颖的策略提取机制来提升性能。

sentences.en: Experiments on standard and real-world offline IL benchmarks show that ReDICE consistently outperforms prior methods and achieves state-of-the-art results.
sentences.zh: 在标准与真实世界的离线 IL 基准上的实验表明，ReDICE 一致地优于先前方法，并取得了最先进的结果。

title_en: Revisiting Efficiency–Accuracy Scaling in Mixture-of-Experts Architectures
title_zh: 重新审视混合专家架构中的效率–准确率缩放

sentences.en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoEs) have become a central component of many state-of-the-art open-source and proprietary large language models.
sentences.zh: 混合专家（MoE）已成为许多最先进的开源与专有大型语言模型的核心组成部分。

sentences.en: Despite their widespread adoption, it remains unclear how close existing MoE architectures are to optimal for inference cost, as measured by accuracy per floating-point operation and per parameter.
sentences.zh: 尽管被广泛采用，但现有 MoE 架构距以每次浮点运算与每参数准确率衡量的推理成本最优还有多远，仍不清楚。

sentences.en: In this work, we revisit MoE design from a hardware-software co-design perspective, grounded in empirical and theoretical considerations.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们从硬件-软件协同设计的视角重新审视 MoE 设计，基于实证与理论考量。

sentences.en: We characterize key performance bottlenecks across diverse deployment regimes, spanning offline high-throughput execution and online, latency-critical inference.
sentences.zh: 我们刻画了跨不同部署场景的关键性能瓶颈，涵盖离线高吞吐执行与在线、延迟关键的推理。

sentences.en: Guided by these insights, we introduce **LatentMoE**, a new model architecture resulting from systematic design exploration and optimized for maximal accuracy per unit of compute.
sentences.zh: 在这些洞见的指导下，我们引入 **LatentMoE**，一个源自系统性设计探索、针对每单位计算的最大准确率进行优化的新型模型架构。

sentences.en: Empirical design space exploration at scales of up to 95B parameters and over a 1T-token training horizon, together with supporting theoretical analysis, shows that LatentMoE consistently outperforms standard MoE architectures in terms of accuracy per FLOP and per parameter.
sentences.zh: 在高达 95B 参数规模与超过 1T 词元训练周期上的实证设计空间探索，以及支持性的理论分析表明，LatentMoE 在每 FLOP 与每参数准确率方面一致地优于标准 MoE 架构。

sentences.en: Given its strong performance, the LatentMoE architecture has been adopted by the flagship Nemotron-3 Super and Ultra models and scaled to substantially larger regimes, including longer token horizons and larger model sizes, as reported in (NVIDIA et al., 2025, arXiv:2512.20856).
sentences.zh: 鉴于其强劲的性能，LatentMoE 架构已被旗舰 Nemotron-3 Super 与 Ultra 模型采用，并扩展到更大的场景，包括更长的词元跨度与更大的模型规模，如 (NVIDIA et al., 2025, arXiv:2512.20856) 所报告的那样。

title_en: Revisiting ML Training under Fully Homomorphic Encryption: Convergence Guarantees, Differential Privacy, and Efficient Algorithms
title_zh: 重新审视完全同态加密下的机器学习训练：收敛保证、差分隐私与高效算法

sentences.en: We present the first theoretical convergence analysis of machine learning training under fully homomorphic encryption (FHE), combined with a differentially private (DP) training algorithm tailored to encrypted computation.
sentences.zh: 我们呈现了完全同态加密（FHE）下机器学习训练的首个理论收敛分析，并结合一种针对加密计算定制的差分隐私（DP）训练算法。

sentences.en: Our approach improves computational efficiency over standard differentially private gradient descent (DP-GD) while achieving comparable utility.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法相比标准的差分隐私梯度下降（DP-GD）提升了计算效率，同时实现了相当的效用。

sentences.en: In particular, we prove convergence of approximate gradient descent using polynomial approximations of activation and loss functions, which are required for FHE compatibility.
sentences.zh: 特别地，我们证明了使用激活函数与损失函数的多项式近似进行近似梯度下降的收敛性，而多项式近似是 FHE 兼容性所必需的。

sentences.en: To preserve privacy in downstream tasks, we integrate differential privacy without relying on costly per-sample gradient clipping, enabling scalable encrypted learning.
sentences.zh: 为在下游任务中保护隐私，我们集成差分隐私，而无需求助昂贵的逐样本梯度裁剪，从而实现可扩展的加密学习。

sentences.en: We also provide data-independent hyperparameter selection and theoretically grounded strategies for polynomial approximation which can be of independent interest.
sentences.zh: 我们还提供与数据无关的超参数选择，以及有理论依据的多项式近似策略，这些可能具有独立的价值。

sentences.en: Together, these contributions advance the feasibility of efficient, private, and secure machine learning on sensitive data.
sentences.zh: 总而言之，这些贡献推动了在敏感数据上进行高效、私密且安全的机器学习的可行性。

authors.name: Antigoni Polychroniadou
authors.institution: J.P. Morgan AI Research & AlgoCRYPT CoE

title_en: Revisiting Neural Processes via Fourier Transform and Volterra Series
title_zh: 通过傅里叶变换与 Volterra 级数重新审视神经过程

sentences.en: Modeling unknown latent functions from finite, irregularly sampled measurements is a recurring challenge across science and engineering.
sentences.zh: 从有限、不规则采样的测量中建模未知的潜在函数，是科学与工程中反复出现的挑战。

sentences.en: Neural processes (NPs), a family of probabilistic functional models, are promising solutions---especially when endowed with domain-specific symmetries like translation equivariance, which improve sample efficiency and generalization.
sentences.zh: 神经过程（NP），一类概率函数模型，是有前景的解决方案——尤其是当它们具备诸如平移等变之类的领域特定对称性时，这种对称性提升了样本效率与泛化能力。

sentences.en: Yet existing translation-equivariant NPs face two limitations: (i) they stack generic components with non-linearities, obscuring the induced function class and limiting interpretability; and (ii) convolutional designs are limited by local receptive fields and the need to embed inputs onto a dense uniform grid, while attention-based alternatives lift these restrictions at quadratic cost in the number of observations.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有的平移等变 NP 存在两个局限：（i）它们堆叠带有非线性的通用组件，掩盖了所诱导的函数类别并限制了可解释性；（ii）卷积设计受限于局部感受野以及将输入嵌入到稠密均匀网格上的需求，而基于注意力的替代方案以观测数量的二次成本解除了这些限制。

sentences.en: We address both with two contributions.
sentences.zh: 我们以两项贡献来解决这两个问题。

sentences.en: First, using the Volterra expansion, we approximate continuous translation-equivariant operators by sums of higher-order convolutions, yielding analytical transparency while admitting efficient evaluation via first-order convolutions.
sentences.zh: 首先，利用 Volterra 展开，我们用高阶卷积的和来逼近连续的平移等变算子，在实现解析透明性的同时，允许通过一阶卷积进行高效求值。

sentences.en: Second, we introduce set Fourier convolutions (SFConvs), a frequency-domain parameterization that operates directly on irregularly sampled points, achieves approximately global receptive fields, and scales linearly in the number of observations.
sentences.zh: 其次，我们引入集合傅里叶卷积（SFConvs），一种频域参数化，它直接在不规则采样点上运作，实现近似全局的感受野，并在观测数量上线性扩展。

sentences.en: Building on these ideas, we propose two conditional NPs (CNPs): SFConvCNPs, which stack SFConv blocks with non-linearities, and SFVConvCNPs, which integrate the Volterra formulation.
sentences.zh: 在这些思想的基础上，我们提出两种条件神经过程（CNP）：SFConvCNPs（堆叠带非线性的 SFConv 块）与 SFVConvCNPs（整合 Volterra 公式）。

sentences.en: Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate our methods' efficacy against state-of-the-art baselines.
sentences.zh: 在合成与真实世界数据集上的实验证明了我们的方法相对最先进基线的有效性。

title_en: Revisiting OOD Generalization in Programmatic RL
title_zh: 重新审视程序化 RL 中的 OOD 泛化

sentences.en: Programmatic policies are often reported to generalize better than neural policies in reinforcement learning (RL) benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 在强化学习（RL）基准中，程序化策略通常被报告为比神经策略具有更好的泛化能力。

sentences.en: We revisit some of these claims and show that much of the observed gap arises from uncontrolled experimental factors rather than intrinsic representational reasons.
sentences.zh: 我们重新审视其中的一些主张，并表明大部分观测到的差距源于不受控的实验因素，而非内在的表示原因。

sentences.en: Re-evaluating three core benchmarks used in influential papers---TORCS, Karel, and Parking---we find that neural policies, when trained with a few modifications, such as sparse observations and cautious intrinsic reward functions, can match or exceed the out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization of programmatic policies.
sentences.zh: 重新评估几篇有影响力论文中使用的三个核心基准——TORCS、Karel 与 Parking——我们发现，神经策略在采用少量修改（如稀疏观测与谨慎的内在奖励函数）进行训练后，可以匹配或超过程序化策略的分布外（OOD）泛化能力。

sentences.en: We argue that a representation enables OOD generalization if (i) the policy space it induces includes a generalizing policy and (ii) the search algorithm can find it.
sentences.zh: 我们认为，当（i）表示所诱导的策略空间包含一个可泛化的策略，且（ii）搜索算法能够找到它时，该表示就支持 OOD 泛化。

sentences.en: The neural and programmatic policies in prior work are comparable in OOD generalization because the domain-specific languages used induce policy spaces similar to those of neural networks, and our modifications help the gradient search find generalizing solutions.
sentences.zh: 先前工作中的神经与程序化策略在 OOD 泛化方面是相当的，因为所用的领域特定语言诱导出与神经网络相似的政策空间，而我们的修改帮助梯度搜索找到可泛化的解。

sentences.en: By disentangling representational factors from experimental confounds, we advance our understanding of what makes a representation succeed or fail at OOD generalization.
sentences.zh: 通过将表示因素与实验混杂因素分离，我们加深了对于什么使一种表示在 OOD 泛化中成功或失败的理解。

title_en: Revisiting Padded Transformer Expressivity: Which Architectural Choices Matter and Which Don't
title_zh: 重新审视填充式 Transformer 的表达能力：哪些架构选择重要，哪些不重要

sentences.en: Recent work describes what transformers can and cannot compute through connections to boolean circuits, but existing results lack exact characterizations and are sensitive to modeling choices.
sentences.zh: 近期工作通过布尔电路的关联性描述了 transformer 能计算什么、不能计算什么，但现有结果缺乏精确刻画，并且对建模选择敏感。

sentences.en: Padded transformers---to whose input filler symbols such as ``...'' are appended---emerge as a useful gadget for establishing equivalences to circuit classes by providing polynomial space for adaptive parallel computation.
sentences.zh: 填充式 transformer——向其输入中追加诸如 “...” 之类的填充符号——通过为自适应并行计算提供多项式空间，成为建立与电路类等价性的有用工具。

sentences.en: However, only a limited set of padded transformer idealizations has been studied, leaving open how robustly these equivalences hold under changes to attention type, model width, and uniformity.
sentences.zh: 然而，目前只研究了有限的填充式 transformer 理想化，这些等价性在注意力类型、模型宽度与均匀性变化下能否稳健地成立，仍悬而未决。

sentences.en: We find that, under practical assumptions, padded transformers are surprisingly robust to all of these, and identify numeric precision and model depth as the main factors affecting expressivity.
sentences.zh: 我们发现，在实用假设下，填充式 transformer 对所有这些都惊人地稳健，并识别出数值精度与模型深度是影响表达能力的主要因素。

sentences.en: Concretely, we prove that polynomially padded $\text{L-uniform}$ constant-precision transformers are equivalent to $\text{L-uniform AC}^0$, while growing-precision ones achieve $\text{L-uniform TC}^0$ regardless of width.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们证明，多项式填充的 $\text{L-uniform}$ 常数精度 transformer 等价于 $\text{L-uniform AC}^0$，而增长精度的则实现 $\text{L-uniform TC}^0$，与宽度无关。

sentences.en: Furthermore, looping enables sequential processing analogous to circuits: $\log^d N$-looped constant-precision transformers reach $\text{FO-uniform AC}^d$, and growing-precision ones reach $\text{FO-uniform TC}^d$.
sentences.zh: 此外，循环使得能够类似电路的顺序处理：$\log^d N$-循环的常数精度 transformer 达到 $\text{FO-uniform AC}^d$，而增长精度的达到 $\text{FO-uniform TC}^d$。

sentences.en: Interestingly, growing width or precision beyond logarithmic does not increase expressivity, and all our results hold for both softmax and average hard attention transformers.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，将宽度或精度增长到超过对数并不会提升表达能力，而且我们的所有结果对 softmax 与平均硬注意力 transformer 都成立。

title_en: Revisiting Parameter-Based Knowledge Editing in Large Language Models: Theoretical Limits and Empirical Evidence
title_zh: 重新审视大语言模型中的基于参数的知识编辑：理论局限与实证证据

sentences.en: Parameter-based knowledge editing updates the internal knowledge of large language models (LLMs) via localized weight modifications and has attracted significant attention.
sentences.zh: 基于参数的知识编辑通过局部权重修改来更新大语言模型（LLM）的内部知识，并已引起显著关注。

sentences.en: However, most existing methods overlook fundamental theoretical limitations and are rarely evaluated under realistic, practice-oriented settings.
sentences.zh: 然而，大多数现有方法忽视了基本的理论局限，并且在现实的、面向实践的场景下很少被评估。

sentences.en: In this paper, we first present a theoretical analysis based on the dimensional Collapse Hypothesis, explaining how localized parameter edits can propagate along fragile directions in the representation space, inducing global interference and ultimately causing reasoning collapse.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们首先给出一个基于维度坍缩假设的理论分析，解释局部参数编辑如何沿着表示空间中的脆弱方向传播，诱发全局干扰，并最终导致推理坍缩。

sentences.en: Building on this insight, we conduct a comprehensive empirical evaluation by systematically varying knowledge complexity, number of edits, evaluation dimensions, and baseline methods.
sentences.zh: 基于这一洞见，我们通过系统性地变化知识复杂性、编辑数量、评估维度与基线方法，进行了全面的实证评估。

sentences.en: Our results show that parameter-based editing methods consistently damage core LLM capabilities.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果表明，基于参数的编辑方法一致地损害了 LLM 的核心能力。

sentences.en: In contrast, a simple retrieval-based baseline achieves consistently stronger performance than all parameter-editing methods across all evaluated conditions.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，一个简单的基于检索的基线在所有评估条件下都取得了比所有参数编辑方法一致更强的性能。

sentences.en: These findings highlight that preserving the fundamental capabilities of LLMs after knowledge editing should be a central concern for future research.
sentences.zh: 这些发现强调，在知识编辑后保持 LLM 的基本能力应是未来研究的核心关切。

title_en: Revisiting Photometric Ambiguity for Accurate Gaussian-Splatting Surface Reconstruction
title_zh: 重新审视用于精确 Gaussian-Splatting 表面重建的光度歧义

sentences.en: Surface reconstruction with differentiable rendering has achieved impressive performance in recent years, yet the pervasive photometric ambiguities have strictly bottlenecked existing approaches.
sentences.zh: 基于可微渲染的表面重建在近年来取得了令人印象深刻的性能，然而普遍存在的光度歧义已严格地成为了现有方法的瓶颈。

sentences.en: This paper presents AmbiSuR, a framework that explores an intrinsic solution upon Gaussian Splatting for the photometric ambiguity-robust surface reconstruction with high performance.
sentences.zh: 本文提出 AmbiSuR，一个在 Gaussian Splatting 之上探索内在解决方案的框架，用于高性能的、对光度歧义鲁棒的表面重建。

sentences.en: Started by revisiting the foundation, our investigation uncovers two built-in primitive-wise ambiguities in representation, while revealing an intrinsic potential for ambiguity self-indication in Gaussian Splatting.
sentences.zh: 从重新审视基础出发，我们的研究揭示了表示中两种内建的、逐基元的光度歧义，同时暴露出 Gaussian Splatting 中歧义自我指示的内在潜力。

sentences.en: Stemming from these, a photometric disambiguation is first introduced, constraining ill-posed geometry solution for definite surface formation.
sentences.zh: 由此出发，我们首先引入一种光度消歧方法，约束病态的几何解以实现明确的表面形成。

sentences.en: Then, we propose an ambiguity indication module that unleashes the self-indication potential to identify and further guide correcting underconstrained reconstructions.
sentences.zh: 随后，我们提出一个歧义指示模块，它释放自我指示的潜力，识别并进一步引导修正约束不足的重建。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate our superior performance in surface reconstruction compared to existing methods across various challenging scenarios, while excelling in broad compatibility.
sentences.zh: 大量实验证明，在多样的挑战性场景中，我们的方法在表面重建方面相比现有方法具有优越的性能，并在广泛的兼容性上表现出色。

sentences.en: Our code will be made open-source upon acceptance.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码将在接收后开源。
