title_en: Riemannian Dueling Optimization
title_zh: 黎曼对偶优化

sentences.en: Dueling optimization considers optimizing an objective with access to only a comparison oracle of the objective function.
sentences.zh: 对偶优化考虑在只有目标函数比较预言机（oracle）可用的情况下优化目标。

sentences.en: It finds important applications in emerging fields such as recommendation systems and robotics.
sentences.zh: 它在推荐系统和机器人等新兴领域具有重要应用。

sentences.en: Existing works on dueling optimization mainly focused on unconstrained problems in the Euclidean space.
sentences.zh: 现有关于对偶优化的研究主要关注欧几里得空间中的无约束问题。

sentences.en: In this work, we study dueling optimization over Riemannian manifolds, which covers important applications that cannot be solved by existing dueling optimization algorithms.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们研究黎曼流形上的对偶优化，这覆盖了现有对偶优化算法无法解决的重要应用。

sentences.en: In particular, we propose a Riemannian Dueling Normalized Gradient Descent (RDNGD) method and establish its iteration complexity when the objective function is geodesically $L$-smooth or geodesically (strongly) convex.
sentences.zh: 特别地，我们提出一种黎曼对偶归一化梯度下降（RDNGD）方法，并在目标函数为测地 $L$-光滑或测地（强）凸时建立其迭代复杂度。

sentences.en: We also propose a projection-free algorithm, named Riemannian Dueling Frank–Wolfe (RDFW) method, to deal with the situation where projection is prohibited.
sentences.zh: 我们还提出一种无投影算法，即黎曼对偶 Frank–Wolfe（RDFW）方法，以处理投影被禁止的情况。

sentences.en: We establish the iteration and oracle complexities for RDFW.
sentences.zh: 我们建立了 RDFW 的迭代复杂度和预言机复杂度。

sentences.en: We illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithms through numerical experiments on both synthetic and real applications.
sentences.zh: 我们通过在合成和真实应用上的数值实验说明了所提算法的有效性。

title_en: Riemannian Generative Decoder
title_zh: 黎曼生成解码器

sentences.en: Euclidean representations distort data with intrinsic non-Euclidean structure.
sentences.zh: 欧几里得表示会扭曲具有内在非欧几里得结构的数据。

sentences.en: While Riemannian representation learning offers a solution by embedding data onto matching manifolds, it typically relies on an encoder to estimate densities on chosen manifolds.
sentences.zh: 虽然黎曼表示学习通过将数据嵌入到匹配的流形上提供了一种解决方案，但它通常依赖编码器来估算所选流形上的密度。

sentences.en: This involves optimizing numerically brittle objectives, potentially harming model training and quality.
sentences.zh: 这涉及优化数值上脆弱的（brittle）目标，可能损害模型训练和质量。

sentences.en: To completely circumvent this issue, we introduce the Riemannian generative decoder, a unifying approach for finding manifold-valued latents on any Riemannian manifold.
sentences.zh: 为彻底规避这一问题，我们提出黎曼生成解码器，这是一种在任意黎曼流形上寻找流形值（manifold-valued）潜变量的统一方法。

sentences.en: Latents are learned with a Riemannian optimizer while jointly training a decoder network.
sentences.zh: 潜变量在联合训练解码器网络的同时，通过黎曼优化器进行学习。

sentences.en: By discarding the encoder, we vastly simplify the manifold constraint compared to current approaches which often only handle few specific manifolds.
sentences.zh: 通过舍弃编码器，与通常只能处理少数特定流形的现有方法相比，我们极大地简化了流形约束。

sentences.en: We validate our approach on three case studies --- a synthetic branching diffusion process, human migrations inferred from mitochondrial DNA, and cells undergoing a cell division cycle --- each showing that learned representations respect the prescribed geometry and capture intrinsic non-Euclidean structure.
sentences.zh: 我们在三个案例研究上验证了我们的方法——合成的分支扩散过程、从线粒体 DNA 推断的人类迁移，以及经历细胞分裂周期的细胞——每个案例都表明，学习到的表示尊重既定几何并捕捉了内在的非欧几里得结构。

sentences.en: Our method requires only a decoder, is compatible with existing architectures, and yields interpretable latent spaces aligned with data geometry.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法只需要一个解码器，与现有架构兼容，并能产生与数据几何对齐的可解释潜空间。

title_en: Riemannian MeanFlow
title_zh: 黎曼 MeanFlow

sentences.en: Diffusion and flow models have become the dominant paradigm for generative modeling on Riemannian manifolds, with successful applications in protein backbone generation and DNA sequence design.
sentences.zh: 扩散模型和流模型已成为在黎曼流形上进行生成式建模的主导范式，并在蛋白质骨架生成和 DNA 序列设计中取得成功应用。

sentences.en: However, these methods require tens to hundreds of neural network evaluations at inference time, which can become a computational bottleneck in large-scale scientific sampling workflows.
sentences.zh: 然而，这些方法在推理时需要数十到数百次神经网络评估，这在大规模科学采样工作流中可能成为计算瓶颈。

sentences.en: We introduce Riemannian MeanFlow (RMF), a framework for learning flow maps directly on manifolds, enabling high-quality generations with as few as one forward pass.
sentences.zh: 我们提出黎曼 MeanFlow（RMF），一个直接在流形上学习流映射的框架，能够以仅一次前向传播实现高质量生成。

sentences.en: We derive three equivalent characterizations of the manifold average velocity (Eulerian, Lagrangian, and semigroup identities), and analyze parameterizations and stabilization techniques to improve training on high-dimensional manifolds.
sentences.zh: 我们推导出流形平均速度的三种等价刻画（欧拉、拉格朗日和半群恒等式），并分析参数化和稳定化技术以改进在高维流形上的训练。

sentences.en: In promoter DNA design and protein backbone generation settings, RMF achieves comparable sample quality to prior methods while requiring up to 10$\times$ fewer function evaluations.
sentences.zh: 在启动子 DNA 设计和蛋白质骨架生成场景中，RMF 在实现与先前方法相当的样本质量的同时，所需函数评估次数最多减少 10$\times$。

sentences.en: Finally, we show that few-step flow maps enable efficient reward-guided design through reward look-ahead, where terminal states can be predicted from intermediate steps at minimal additional cost.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们证明少步流映射通过奖励前瞻实现高效的奖励引导设计，其中可以以极小的额外代价从中间步骤预测终止状态。

title_en: Riemannian MeanFlow for One-Step Generation on Manifolds
title_zh: 面向流形上单步生成的黎曼 MeanFlow

sentences.en: Flow Matching enables simulation-free training of generative models on Riemannian manifolds, yet sampling typically still relies on numerically integrating a probability-flow ODE.
sentences.zh: 流匹配（Flow Matching）使得在黎曼流形上无需模拟即可训练生成模型成为可能，然而采样通常仍依赖对概率流 ODE 进行数值积分。

sentences.en: We propose Riemannian MeanFlow (RMF), extending MeanFlow to manifold-valued generation where velocities lie in location-dependent tangent spaces.
sentences.zh: 我们提出黎曼 MeanFlow（RMF），将 MeanFlow 扩展到流形值的生成，其中速度位于随位置变化的切空间内。

sentences.en: RMF defines an average-velocity field via parallel transport and derives a Riemannian MeanFlow identity that links average and instantaneous velocities for intrinsic supervision.
sentences.zh: RMF 通过平行移动定义平均速度场，并推导出联系平均速度与瞬时速度的黎曼 MeanFlow 恒等式，用于内在监督。

sentences.en: We make this identity practical in a log-map tangent representation, avoiding trajectory simulation and heavy geometric computations.
sentences.zh: 我们使该恒等式在对数映射切表示下具有实用性，从而避免了轨迹模拟和繁重的几何计算。

sentences.en: For stable optimization, we decompose the RMF objective into two terms and apply conflict-aware multi-task learning to mitigate gradient interference.
sentences.zh: 为实现稳定的优化，我们将 RMF 目标分解为两项，并应用冲突感知的多任务学习来缓解梯度干扰。

sentences.en: RMF also supports conditional generation via classifier-free guidance.
sentences.zh: RMF 还通过无分类器引导支持条件生成。

sentences.en: Experiments on spheres, tori, SO(3), and SE(3) demonstrate competitive one-step sampling with improved quality–efficiency trade-offs and substantially reduced sampling cost.
sentences.zh: 在球面、环面、SO(3) 和 SE(3) 上的实验表明，RMF 具有竞争力的单步采样性能、更优的质量-效率权衡，并大幅降低了采样成本。

title_en: Riemannian Metric Matching for Scalable Geometric Modeling of Distributions
title_zh: 用于分布可扩展几何建模的黎曼度量匹配

sentences.en: High-dimensional datasets often concentrate near low-dimensional structures, but estimating their geometry from samples typically relies on graphs and kernels that scale poorly with dataset size and dimension.
sentences.zh: 高维数据集往往集中于低维结构附近，但从样本中估计其几何结构通常依赖图和核方法，而这些方法在数据集规模和维度增大时扩展性很差。

sentences.en: We propose **Riemannian metric matching**: a denoising probabilistic framework for learning the Riemannian geometry of data using neural networks.
sentences.zh: 我们提出**黎曼度量匹配（Riemannian metric matching）**：一个使用神经网络学习数据黎曼几何的去噪概率框架。

sentences.en: Specifically, we learn the *carré du champ* operator, which, using diffusion geometry, gives us access to the Riemannian geometry toolkit for downstream machine learning and statistical tasks.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们学习*carré du champ*算子，它利用扩散几何使我们能够使用黎曼几何工具箱来处理下游机器学习和统计任务。

sentences.en: Our key observation is that the carré du champ operator can be formulated as a conditional expectation over random perturbations of the data, which can be exploited for sample-wise training and constant cost, amortized inference without explicit kernel construction.
sentences.zh: 我们的关键观察是，carré du champ 算子可以表述为对数据随机扰动的条件期望，这可用于逐样本训练以及无需显式构造核的恒定代价摊销推断。

sentences.en: To the best of our knowledge, we provide the first neural surrogate that estimates the underlying Riemannian geometry of data with a provable consistency guarantee in the large data limit.
sentences.zh: 据我们所知，我们提供了第一个神经代理，它能在大数据极限下以可证明的一致性保证来估计数据底层的黎曼几何。

sentences.en: Empirically, metric matching rivals or improves the accuracy of $k$-NN-based diffusion geometry estimators, while enabling amortized inference that is up to $400\times$ faster, and supports graph-free geometric analysis on high-dimensional images where nearest neighbors break down.
sentences.zh: 在实验上，度量匹配达到或提升了基于 $k$-NN 的扩散几何估计器的精度，同时实现快达 $400\times$ 的摊销推断，并支持在最近邻失效的高维图像上进行无图几何分析。

title_en: Riemannian Networks over Full-Rank Correlation Matrices
title_zh: 全秩相关矩阵上的黎曼网络

sentences.en: Representations on the Symmetric Positive Definite (SPD) manifold have garnered significant attention across different applications.
sentences.zh: 对称正定（SPD）流形上的表示已在不同应用中获得广泛关注。

sentences.en: In contrast, the manifold of full-rank correlation matrices, a normalized alternative to SPD matrices, remains largely underexplored.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，全秩相关矩阵流形作为 SPD 矩阵的一种归一化替代，在很大程度上仍未被充分探索。

sentences.en: This paper introduces Riemannian networks over the correlation manifold, leveraging five recently developed correlation geometries.
sentences.zh: 本文提出了相关矩阵流形上的黎曼网络，利用了五种最新发展的相关几何。

sentences.en: We systematically extend basic layers, including Multinomial Logistic Regression (MLR), Fully Connected (FC), and convolutional layers, to these geometries.
sentences.zh: 我们系统地将基本层，包括多项逻辑回归（MLR）、全连接（FC）和卷积层，扩展到这些几何结构。

sentences.en: Besides, we present methods for accurate backpropagation for two correlation geometries.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们提出了针对两种相关几何的精确反向传播方法。

sentences.en: Experiments comparing our approach against existing SPD and Grassmannian networks demonstrate its effectiveness.
sentences.zh: 将我们的方法与现有的 SPD 网络和 Grassmann 流形网络进行比较的实验证明了其有效性。

authors.name: Bernhard Schölkopf
authors.institution: MPI for Intelligent Systems Tübingen, Germany

title_en: Riemannian Neural Optimal Transport
title_zh: 黎曼神经最优传输

sentences.en: Computational optimal transport (OT) offers a principled framework for generative modeling.
sentences.zh: 计算最优传输（OT）为生成式建模提供了一个有原则（principled）的框架。

sentences.en: Neural OT methods, which use neural networks to learn an OT map (or potential) from data in an amortized way, can be evaluated out of sample after training, but existing approaches are tailored to Euclidean geometry.
sentences.zh: 神经 OT 方法使用神经网络以摊销的方式从数据中学习 OT 映射（或势函数），训练后可以在样本外进行评估，但现有方法是为欧几里得几何量身定制的。

sentences.en: Extending neural OT to high-dimensional Riemannian manifolds remains an open challenge.
sentences.zh: 将神经 OT 扩展到高维黎曼流形仍是一个开放挑战。

sentences.en: In this paper, we prove that any method for OT on manifolds that produces discrete approximations of transport maps necessarily suffers from the curse of dimensionality: achieving a fixed accuracy requires a number of parameters that grows exponentially with the manifold dimension.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们证明，任何在流形上生成传输映射离散近似的 OT 方法都必然遭受维度灾难：要达到固定精度，所需的参数数量会随流形维数呈指数增长。

sentences.en: Motivated by this limitation, we introduce Riemannian Neural OT (RNOT) maps, which are continuous neural-network parameterizations of OT maps on manifolds that avoid discretization and incorporate geometric structure by construction.
sentences.zh: 受这一局限的启发，我们提出黎曼神经 OT（RNOT）映射，它是流形上 OT 映射的连续神经网络参数化，避免了离散化，并通过构造融入几何结构。

sentences.en: Under mild regularity assumptions, we prove that RNOT maps approximate Riemannian OT maps with sub-exponential complexity in the dimension.
sentences.zh: 在温和的正则性假设下，我们证明 RNOT 映射能以关于维数的次指数复杂度逼近黎曼 OT 映射。

sentences.en: Experiments on synthetic and real datasets demonstrate improved scalability and competitive performance relative to discretization-based baselines.
sentences.zh: 在合成和真实数据集上的实验表明，与基于离散化的基线相比，RNOT 具有更好的可扩展性和有竞争力的性能。

title_en: Riemannian Optimization for Fair Spectral Clustering
title_zh: 面向公平谱聚类的黎曼优化

sentences.en: Fair graph clustering has emerged as a critical research area for addressing algorithmic bias in machine learning.
sentences.zh: 公平图聚类已成为解决机器学习中算法偏差的关键研究领域。

sentences.en: The objective is to ensure that the proportion of each protected group within a cluster is consistent with its representation in the entire dataset.
sentences.zh: 其目标是确保聚类中每个受保护群体的比例与其在整个数据集中的占比一致。

sentences.en: However, most existing spectral solutions rely on computationally expensive eigendecompositions of the graph Laplacian, limiting their scalability.
sentences.zh: 然而，大多数现有的谱方法依赖计算开销巨大的图拉普拉斯特征分解，限制了其可扩展性。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose Riemannian Fair Spectral Clustering (R-FairSC), a novel method that formulates fair spectral clustering as a constrained optimization problem on a Riemannian manifold.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出黎曼公平谱聚类（R-FairSC），一种将公平谱聚类表述为黎曼流形上有约束优化问题的新方法。

sentences.en: We develop a Riemannian alternating direction method of multipliers employing a variable-splitting strategy to efficiently solve the associated subproblems.
sentences.zh: 我们开发了一种采用变量分裂策略的黎曼交替方向乘子法，以高效求解相关的子问题。

sentences.en: Numerical experiments on large synthetic and real-world graphs demonstrate that R-FairSC significantly improves computational efficiency over state-of-the-art methods while maintaining high clustering quality and fairness.
sentences.zh: 在大型合成和真实世界图上的数值实验表明，与最先进的方法相比，R-FairSC 在保持高聚类质量和公平性的同时显著提高了计算效率。

title_en: Riemannian stochastic optimization for sufficient dimension reduction
title_zh: 用于充分降维的黎曼随机优化

sentences.en: Sufficient dimension reduction (SDR) makes high-dimensional regression tractable by projecting the covariates onto a low-dimensional subspace that preserves the conditional mean of the response.
sentences.zh: 充分降维（SDR）通过将协变量投影到保留响应条件均值的低维子空间上，使高维回归变得易于处理。

sentences.en: Existing gradient-based estimators either operate in the ambient space and suffer from the curse of dimensionality, or localize in the reduced space at a per-outer-iteration cost at least quadratic in the sample size.
sentences.zh: 现有的基于梯度的估计器要在环境空间中运行而遭受维度灾难，要么在约化空间中局部化，其每次外部迭代的成本至少与样本量的平方相当。

sentences.en: We show that minimizers of the population Minimum Average Variance Estimation (MAVE) risk approximate the same Grassmannian target as the Outer Product of Gradients (OPG), and recast the empirical criterion as a smooth maximization on the Stiefel manifold with closed-form Riemannian gradient.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，总体最小平均方差估计（MAVE）风险的最小化器逼近与梯度外积（OPG）相同的 Grassmann 流形目标，并将经验准则重新表述为 Stiefel 流形上具有闭式黎曼梯度的光滑最大化问题。

sentences.en: The resulting algorithm, SMAVE, combines sparse projected-space nearest-neighbor localization with Riemannian stochastic gradient ascent.
sentences.zh: 由此产生的算法 SMAVE 将稀疏投影空间最近邻定位与黎曼随机梯度上升相结合。

sentences.en: A simplified version comes with almost-sure convergence and a non-asymptotic rate matching the standard non-convex stochastic first-order scaling.
sentences.zh: 一个简化版本具有几乎必然收敛性，以及匹配标准非凸随机一阶缩放的渐近率。

sentences.en: Empirically, SMAVE matches or improves on RMAVE's synthetic subspace recovery at moderate-to-high ambient dimension, and on four real datasets it uniformly improves over OPG and is competitive with or outperforms RMAVE at orders of magnitude lower runtime.
sentences.zh: 在实验上，在中高环境维度下，SMAVE 在合成子空间恢复方面达到或优于 RMAVE；在四个真实数据集上，SMAVE 稳定优于 OPG，并在运行时间低数个数量级的情况下与 RMAVE 相当或优于 RMAVE。

title_en: Ripple Perturbations Through Structure: Likelihood-Constrained Adversarial Attacks on Heterogeneous Tabular Data
title_zh: 经由结构的涟漪扰动：异构表格数据上的似然约束对抗攻击

sentences.en: Generating realistic adversarial examples for tabular data remains challenging due to heterogeneous feature types and asymmetric inter-feature dependencies.
sentences.zh: 由于特征的异构类型和特征间的非对称依赖，为表格数据生成逼真的对抗样本仍然具有挑战性。

sentences.en: Existing approaches typically rely on handcrafted constraints or undirected similarity criteria to delimit the feasible attack region, which often fail to capture the structural dependency governing tabular generation.
sentences.zh: 现有方法通常依赖手工设计的约束或无向相似性准则来界定可行的攻击区域，这往往无法捕获支配表格生成的结构依赖。

sentences.en: Consequently, standard attacks typically produce perturbations that are statistically likely yet semantically inconsistent and prone to optimization stagnation via gradient masking.
sentences.zh: 因此，标准攻击通常产生的扰动虽然在统计上可行，但语义上不一致，并且容易因梯度掩蔽而导致优化停滞。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose LCSA, a white-box framework that formulates adversarial generation as optimization over structurally admissible perturbations.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出 LCSA，一个将对抗生成表述为在结构可行扰动上进行优化的白盒框架。

sentences.en: LCSA leverages an ensemble of heterogeneous neural Structural Causal Models to infer dependencies and introduces a structure-aware ripple mechanism.
sentences.zh: LCSA 利用异构神经结构因果模型的集成来推断依赖关系，并引入了一种结构感知的涟漪机制。

sentences.en: Unlike attacks that perturb features in isolation, this mechanism propagates updates downstream, acting as a structural preconditioner that conditions gradient flow to mitigate masking effects.
sentences.zh: 与单独扰动特征（perturb features in isolation）的攻击不同，该机制将更新向下游传播，充当结构预条件子，对梯度流进行条件化以缓解掩蔽效应。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that LCSA outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in 45 of 50 evaluated configurations, yielding adversarial examples with superior structural consistency and transferability.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，在 50 种评估配置中有 45 种配置下，LCSA 优于最先进的基线，生成的对抗样本具有更好的结构一致性和可迁移性。

title_en: Risk Awareness Injection: Calibrating Vision-Language Models for Safety without Compromising Utility
title_zh: 风险感知注入：在不损害实用性的前提下校准视觉语言模型的安全性能

sentences.en: Vision language models (VLMs) extend the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) to cross-modal settings, yet remain highly vulnerable to multimodal jailbreak attacks.
sentences.zh: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）将大型语言模型（LLMs）的推理能力扩展到跨模态设置，但仍极易受到多模态越狱攻击。

sentences.en: Existing defenses predominantly rely on safety fine-tuning or \textit{aggressive} token manipulations, incurring substantial training costs or significantly degrading utility.
sentences.zh: 现有的防御主要依赖安全微调或 \textit{aggressive} 的 token 操作，这会带来高昂的训练成本或显著降低实用性。

sentences.en: Recent research shows that LLMs inherently recognize unsafe content in text, and the incorporation of visual inputs in VLMs frequently dilutes risk-related signals.
sentences.zh: 近期研究表明，LLMs 能够从本质上识别文本中的不安全内容，而 VLMs 中视觉输入的融入常常会稀释与风险相关的信号。

sentences.en: Motivated by this, we propose Risk Awareness Injection (RAI), a \textit{lightweight} and training-free framework for safety calibration that restores LLM-like risk recognition by amplifying unsafe signals in VLMs.
sentences.zh: 受此启发，我们提出风险感知注入（RAI），一个 \textit{lightweight} 且免训练的安全校准框架，它通过放大 VLMs 中的不安全信号来恢复类似 LLM 的风险识别能力。

sentences.en: Specifically, RAI constructs an Unsafe Prototype Subspace from language embeddings and performs targeted modulation on selected high-risk visual tokens, explicitly activating safety-critical signals within the cross-modal feature space.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，RAI 从语言嵌入中构建一个不安全原型子空间（Unsafe Prototype Subspace），并对选定的高风险视觉 token 进行定向调制，在跨模态特征空间中显式激活安全关键的信号。

sentences.en: This modulation restores the model’s LLM-like ability to detect unsafe content from visual inputs, while preserving the semantic integrity of original tokens for cross-modal reasoning.
sentences.zh: 这种调制恢复了模型从视觉输入中检测不安全内容的类 LLM 能力，同时保留原始 token 的语义完整性以用于跨模态推理。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across multiple jailbreak and utility benchmarks demonstrate that RAI substantially reduces attack success rate without compromising task performance.
sentences.zh: 在多个越狱和实用性基准上的大量实验表明，RAI 在不损害任务性能的前提下大幅降低了攻击成功率。

title_en: Risk-Averse and Optimistic Advertiser Incentive Compatibility in Auto-bidding
title_zh: 自动出价中风险规避与乐观型广告主激励相容性

sentences.en: The rise of auto-bidding in online advertising has created new challenges for ensuring advertiser incentive compatibility, particularly when advertisers delegate bidding to agents with high-level constraints.
sentences.zh: 在线广告中自动出价的兴起为确保广告主激励相容性带来了新的挑战，尤其是当广告主将出价委托给带有高层级约束的智能体时。

sentences.en: One challenge is the multiplicity of equilibria with reported constraints.
sentences.zh: 一个挑战在于，在已上报约束的情况下可能存在多重均衡。

sentences.en: Alimohammadi et al. (2023) proposed a notion of Auto-bidding Incentive Compatibility (AIC) which serves to highlight that standard auctions may not incentivize truthful reporting of these constraints.
sentences.zh: Alimohammadi 等人（2023）提出了自动出价激励相容性（AIC）的概念，用以强调标准拍卖可能无法激励对这些约束的真实上报。

sentences.en: However, their definition of AIC is very stringent as it requires that the worst-case outcome of an advertiser's truthful report is at least as good as the best-case outcome of any of the advertiser's possible deviations.
sentences.zh: 然而，他们对 AIC 的定义非常严格，因为它要求广告主真实上报的最坏情形结果至少不差于其任何可能偏离行为的最好情形结果。

sentences.en: In this paper, we introduce two refined and relaxed concepts: Risk-Averse Auto-bidding Incentive Compatibility (RAIC) and Optimistic Auto-bidding Incentive Compatibility (OAIC).
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们引入两个经过改进和放宽的概念：风险规避型自动出价激励相容性（RAIC）和乐观型自动出价激励相容性（OAIC）。

sentences.en: RAIC (OAIC) stipulates that truthful reporting is preferred if its least (most) favorable equilibrium outcome is no worse than the least (most) favorable equilibrium outcome from any misreport.
sentences.zh: RAIC（OAIC）规定，若真实上报的最差（最好）均衡结果不劣于任何误报的最差（最好）均衡结果，则真实上报是更优选的。

sentences.en: We demonstrate that SPA satisfies both RAIC and OAIC.
sentences.zh: 我们证明 SPA 同时满足 RAIC 和 OAIC。

sentences.en: These findings clarify SPA's incentive properties under auto-bidding, specifically regarding advertiser perspectives on equilibrium selection.
sentences.zh: 这些发现阐明了 SPA 在自动出价下的激励性质，特别是关于广告主对均衡选择视角的激励性质。

title_en: Risk-Bounded Distribution Reconstruction: Stable Statistic Calibration for Long-Tailed Recognition
title_zh: 风险有界分布重建：长尾识别的稳定统计校准

sentences.en: Long-tailed recognition suffers from extreme class imbalance, where scarce tail data leads to biased and fragile feature distributions that exacerbate confusion with semantically or visually similar classes.
sentences.zh: 长尾识别受极端类别不平衡的困扰，稀缺的尾部数据导致有偏差且脆弱的特征分布，从而加剧了与语义或视觉相似类别的混淆。

sentences.en: Prior feature-space reconstruction methods transfer head-class structure or train conditional generators to synthesize tail features, yet the resulting \emph{statistical} updates are often heuristic and can degrade multi-class separability when tail estimates are unreliable.
sentences.zh: 先前的特征空间重建方法会迁移头部类别结构或训练条件生成器来合成尾部特征，然而由此产生的\emph{统计}更新往往是启发式的，当尾部估计不可靠时可能会降低多类别可分性。

sentences.en: Given this issue, we propose \emph{Risk-Bounded Distribution Reconstruction} (RBDR), an offline statistic calibration framework for the two-stage long-tailed pipeline, grounded in an analysis of rival-induced discriminative directions.
sentences.zh: 针对这一问题，我们提出\emph{风险有界分布重建}（RBDR），一个面向两阶段长尾流程的离线统计校准框架，它基于对竞争诱导的判别方向的分析。

sentences.en: RBDR performs (i) risk-aware mean calibration by softly projecting any candidate update onto a supportive set such that a surrogate discriminative-risk upper bound does not increase, and (ii) covariance control by shrinking dispersion in a rival subspace while preserving diversity in orthogonal components.
sentences.zh: RBDR 执行（i）风险感知的均值校准，将任何候选更新软投影到支持集上，使得代理判别风险上界不增加；（ii）协方差控制，在竞争子空间中收缩离散度，同时保留正交分量中的多样性。

sentences.en: In the frozen-feature reconstruction setting, these calibration components convert heuristic reconstruction cues into controllable distributional updates, improving both performance and stability across multiple long-tailed benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 在冻结特征重建设置中，这些校准组件将启发式的重建线索转化为可控的分布更新，在多个长尾基准上同时提高了性能和稳定性。

title_en: RiskZero: Plan More to Risk Less with a Learned Model
title_zh: RiskZero：用学习到的模型多做规划以少冒风险

sentences.en: *AlphaZero* and *MuZero* have demonstrated superhuman performance across a range of strategic tasks.
sentences.zh: *AlphaZero* 和 *MuZero* 已在多种策略任务中展现出超人类的表现水平。

sentences.en: Yet their reliance on maximizing expected returns limits their use in real-world settings, where even high-return policies may incur rare but catastrophic failures.
sentences.zh: 然而，它们对最大化期望回报的依赖限制了其在真实世界环境中的使用，因为在真实世界中，即使是高回报策略也可能遭遇罕见但灾难性的失败。

sentences.en: We introduce *RiskZero* to address this limitation; the first *MuZero*-family method for risk-sensitive decision-making, and planning with *zero* prior knowledge of environment dynamics.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 *RiskZero* 来解决这一局限；它是第一个用于风险敏感决策的 *MuZero* 家族方法，并且在对环境动态零先验知识的情况下进行规划。

sentences.en: *RiskZero* learns distributional quantities to estimate trajectory-level risk, guiding search toward policies that explicitly avoid rare but severe outcomes.
sentences.zh: *RiskZero* 学习分布量以估计轨迹层面的风险，从而引导搜索走向显式避免罕见但严重后果的策略。

sentences.en: We establish theoretical convergence to optimal, stationary risk-sensitive policies and validate our approach on environments designed to test risk-sensitive learning from pixels, as well as on larger-scale combinatorial tasks.
sentences.zh: 我们建立了收敛到最优、平稳的风险敏感策略的理论保证，并在为测试从像素中进行风险敏感学习而设计的环境以及更大规模的组合任务上验证了我们的方法。

sentences.en: Across all settings, *RiskZero* consistently outperforms state-of-the-art risk-sensitive baselines, and improves sample efficiency, providing a general framework for safer and reliable model-based reinforcement learning under uncertainty.
sentences.zh: 在所有设置中，*RiskZero* 始终优于最先进的风险敏感基线，并提高了样本效率，为不确定环境下更安全、更可靠的基于模型的强化学习提供了一个通用框架。

title_en: RL with Learnable Textual Feedback: A Bilevel Approach
title_zh: 具有可学习文本反馈的强化学习：一种双层方法

sentences.en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards can improve LLM reasoning, but learning remains sample-inefficient when terminal rewards are sparse.
sentences.zh: 具有可验证奖励的强化学习可以改进 LLM 的推理能力，但当目标奖励稀疏时，学习的样本效率仍然很低。

sentences.en: This has motivated a growing line of work on RL with textual feedback, where a critic model generates natural language feedback to guide a reasoning model (the actor), augmenting scalar rewards with richer learning signals.
sentences.zh: 这推动了关于带文本反馈强化学习的一系列日益增多的研究，其中评论家（critic）模型生成自然语言反馈来指导推理模型（actor），用更丰富的学习信号增强标量奖励。

sentences.en: However, existing methods typically treat feedback as fixed or auxiliary, which misses a key property: feedback should not merely be correct, but should improve the policy (actor model) when provided in context.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有方法通常将反馈视为固定或辅助的，这忽略一个关键特性：反馈不仅应当是正确的，而且当在上下文中提供时，还应当改进策略（actor 模型）。

sentences.en: This motivates a paradigm of \textit{learnable textual feedback for RL}.
sentences.zh: 这催生了一种\textit{面向 RL 的可学习文本反馈}范式。

sentences.en: Yet the learnability and usefulness of feedback depend on the policy's ability to learn from it, making RL with learnable feedback an inherently bilevel problem.
sentences.zh: 然而，反馈的可学习性和有用性取决于策略从中学习的能力，这使得带可学习反馈的强化学习本质上成为一个双层问题。

sentences.en: We formalize this coupling as a Stackelberg bilevel program and derive \emph{Bilevel Natural Language Actor-Critic} (Bi-NAC), which jointly trains a critic to generate reward-improving feedback and an actor to exploit it.
sentences.zh: 我们将这种耦合形式化为一个 Stackelberg 双层规划，并推导出\emph{双层自然语言 Actor-Critic}（Bi-NAC），它联合训练一个评论家来生成能改进奖励的反馈，以及一个 actor 来利用这些反馈。

sentences.en: Across MATH-500, MBPP, and GPQA, Bi-NAC improves sample and parameter efficiency over RL and fixed-critic baselines: our 2B model outperforms the 3B GRPO baseline, achieving 46.6% versus 41.4% on MATH-500, while our 6B model surpasses the 7B GRPO baseline, achieving 49.3% versus 43.6% on GPQA.
sentences.zh: 在 MATH-500、MBPP 和 GPQA 上，与 RL 和固定评论家基线相比，Bi-NAC 提高了样本效率和参数效率：我们的 2B 模型优于 3B GRPO 基线，在 MATH-500 上取得 46.6% 对 41.4% 的成绩；而我们的 6B 模型超过了 7B GRPO 基线，在 GPQA 上取得 49.3% 对 43.6% 的成绩。

sentences.en: Our code is available at [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/sid-in-the-loop/Bi-Natural-Language-Actor-Critic/).
sentences.zh: 我们的代码见 [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/sid-in-the-loop/Bi-Natural-Language-Actor-Critic/)。

title_en: RL-SPH: Learning to Achieve Feasible Solutions for Integer Linear Programs
title_zh: RL-SPH：学习为整数线性规划求得可行解

sentences.en: Primal heuristics play a crucial role in quickly finding feasible solutions for NP-hard integer linear programming (ILP).
sentences.zh: 原始启发式（primal heuristics）在快速寻找 NP 难整数线性规划（ILP）的可行解方面发挥着关键作用。

sentences.en: Although $\textit{end-to-end learning}$-based primal heuristics (E2EPH) have recently been proposed, they are typically unable to independently generate feasible solutions.
sentences.zh: 尽管最近提出了基于$\textit{end-to-end learning}$的原始启发式方法（E2EPH），但它们通常无法独立生成可行解。

sentences.en: To address this challenge, we propose RL-SPH, a novel reinforcement learning-based start primal heuristic capable of independently generating feasible solutions, even for ILP involving non-binary integers.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一挑战，我们提出 RL-SPH，一种基于强化学习的新颖起始原始启发式（start primal heuristic），它能够独立生成可行解，即使对于涉及非二元整数的 ILP 也是如此。

sentences.en: Empirically, RL-SPH rapidly obtains high-quality feasible solutions with a 100% feasibility rate, achieving on average a 28.6$\times$ lower primal gap and a 2.6$\times$ lower primal integral compared to existing start primal heuristics.
sentences.zh: 在实验上，RL-SPH 能以 100% 的可行性率快速获得高质量的可行解，与现有的起始原始启发式方法相比，平均将原始间隙降低 28.6$\times$，将原始积分降低 2.6$\times$。

title_en: RL4RLA: Teaching ML to Discover Randomized Linear Algebra Algorithms Through Curriculum Design and Graph-Based Search
title_zh: RL4RLA：通过课程设计与基于图的搜索教会机器学习发现随机线性代数算法

sentences.en: Randomized linear algebra (RLA) algorithms are a modern class of numerical linear algebra techniques that play an essential role in scientific computing and machine learning, with broad and growing adoption.
sentences.zh: 随机线性代数（RLA）算法是一类现代的数值线性代数技术，在科学计算和机器学习中发挥着至关重要的作用，并且其应用日益广泛。

sentences.en: However, their discovery remains mostly a manual process that requires deep expert knowledge and inspiration.
sentences.zh: 然而，它们的发现大多是手动过程，需要深厚的专家知识和灵感。

sentences.en: While Reinforcement Learning (RL) offers a pathway to automation, standard approaches struggle with sparse reward landscapes and vast search spaces inherent to high-performing RLA algorithms.
sentences.zh: 虽然强化学习（RL）提供了一条自动化路径，但标准方法在面对高性能 RLA 算法固有的稀疏奖励景观和广阔搜索空间时显得力不从心。

sentences.en: In this paper, we present RL4RLA, a general RL framework that automates the discovery of interpretable, symbolic RLA algorithms.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出 RL4RLA，一个使可解释的符号化 RLA 算法发现过程自动化的通用 RL 框架。

sentences.en: Unlike black-box approaches, our method builds explicit algorithms from basic linear algebra primitives, ensuring verifiable and implementable representations.
sentences.zh: 与黑盒方法不同，我们的方法从基本线性代数原语构建显式算法，确保得到可验证且可实现的表示。

sentences.en: To enable efficient discovery, we introduce: (1) a numerical curriculum that progressively increments problem difficulty to encode inductive bias specific to the RLA domain;
sentences.zh: 为实现高效发现，我们引入：（1）一个数值课程（curriculum），通过逐步增加问题难度来编码 RLA 领域特有的归纳偏差；

sentences.en: (2) Monte Carlo Graph Search, which optimizes exploration by identifying and merging equivalent partial algorithms.
sentences.zh: （2）蒙特卡洛图搜索（Monte Carlo Graph Search），通过识别并合并等价的局部算法来优化探索。

sentences.en: We demonstrate that RL4RLA rediscovers state-of-the-art methods, including sketch-and-precondition solvers, Randomized Kaczmarz, and Newton Sketch, and can be targeted to produce algorithms optimized for specific trade-offs between accuracy, speed, and stability.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，RL4RLA 能重新发现最先进的方法，包括 sketch-and-precondition 求解器、Randomized Kaczmarz 和 Newton Sketch，并且可以针对精度、速度和稳定性之间的特定权衡进行目标设定，以生成相应的优化算法。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/Tim-Xiong/RL4RLA.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/Tim-Xiong/RL4RLA 获取。

title_en: RLAnything: Forge Environment, Policy, and Reward Model in Completely Dynamic RL System
title_zh: RLAnything：在完全动态的强化学习系统中锻造环境、策略与奖励模型

sentences.en: The quality of both the environment and the reward model fundamentally governs the effectiveness of reinforcement learning.
sentences.zh: 环境与奖励模型的质量从根本上决定了强化学习的有效性。

sentences.en: Accordingly, we propose RLAnything, a reinforcement learning framework that dynamically optimizes each component through closed-loop optimization, amplifying learning signals and strengthening the overall system.
sentences.zh: 相应地，我们提出 RLAnything，一个通过闭环优化动态优化各组成部分的强化学习框架，从而放大学习信号并增强整个系统。

sentences.en: Specifically, the policy is trained with integrated feedback from step-wise and outcome signals, while the reward model is jointly optimized via consistency feedback, which in turn further improves policy training.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，策略使用来自逐步信号和结果信号的整合反馈进行训练，而奖励模型则通过一致性反馈进行联合优化，这进而进一步改进策略训练。

sentences.en: Moreover, our theory-motivated automatic environment adaptation improves training for both the reward and policy models by leveraging critic feedback from each, enabling learning from experience.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们受理论驱动的自动环境适应通过利用各自的评论家反馈来改进奖励模型和策略模型的训练，从而实现从经验中学习。

sentences.en: Empirically, each added component consistently improves the overall system, and RLAnything yields substantial gains in practical applications, boosting Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking by 8.5% on OSWorld and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct by 21.2% and 12.1% on AlfWorld and LiveBench, respectively.
sentences.zh: 在实验上，每个新增组件都持续改进整个系统，且 RLAnything 在实际应用中带来显著提升，将 Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking 在 OSWorld 上提升 8.5%，并将 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 分别在 AlfWorld 和 LiveBench 上提升 21.2% 和 12.1%。

title_en: RLCracker: Evaluating the Worst-Case Vulnerability of LLM Watermarks with Adaptive RL Attacks
title_zh: RLCracker：用自适应 RL 攻击评估 LLM 水印的最坏情况脆弱性

sentences.en: Large language model (LLM) watermarking has shown promise in detecting AI-generated content and mitigating misuse, with prior work claiming robustness against paraphrasing and text editing.
sentences.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）水印技术在检测 AI 生成内容、减轻滥用方面显示出潜力，先前的工作声称它对改写和文本编辑具有稳健性。

sentences.en: In this paper, we argue that existing evaluations are not sufficiently adversarial, obscuring critical vulnerabilities and overstating the security.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们认为现有评估的对抗性不足，掩盖了关键脆弱性并夸大了安全性。

sentences.en: To address this, we introduce the *adaptive robustness radius*, a formal metric that quantifies the worst-case resilience of watermarks against adaptive adversaries.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们引入*自适应稳健半径（adaptive robustness radius）*，这是一个形式化指标，用于量化水印在自适应对手面前的最坏情况韧性。

sentences.en: By lifting the paraphrase space into a KL-divergence ball, we approximate this radius and theoretically demonstrate that optimizing the attack context and model parameters can significantly reduce the approximated radius, making watermarks highly vulnerable to paraphrase attacks.
sentences.zh: 通过将改写空间提升到 KL 散度球中，我们对该半径进行近似，并从理论上证明，优化攻击上下文和模型参数可以显著减小近似半径，从而使水印极易受到改写攻击。

sentences.en: Leveraging this insight, we propose RLCracker, a reinforcement learning (RL)–based adaptive attack that erases watermarks while preserving semantic fidelity.
sentences.zh: 利用这一洞察，我们提出 RLCracker，一种基于强化学习（RL）的自适应攻击方法，它在保持语义保真度的同时抹除水印。

sentences.en: RLCracker requires only *limited* watermarked examples and *zero* access to the detector.
sentences.zh: RLCracker 只需要*有限的*水印样本，并且*无需*访问检测器。

sentences.en: Despite weak supervision, it empowers a 3B model to achieve 98.5\% removal success with minimal semantic shift on 1,500-token Unigram-marked texts after training on only *100* short samples.
sentences.zh: 尽管监督较弱，它仅需在*100*个短样本上训练，就能让一个 3B 模型在 1,500 个 token 的 Unigram 标记文本上实现 98.5\% 的移除成功率，且语义偏移极小。

sentences.en: This performance dramatically exceeds 6.75\% by GPT-4o and generalizes across five model sizes over ten watermarking schemes.
sentences.zh: 这一性能远超 GPT-4o 的 6.75\%，并在十种水印方案、五种模型规模上均具有泛化性。

sentences.en: Our code is available in this repository.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在本仓库中获取。

title_en: RLIE: Rule Generation with Logistic Regression, Iterative Refinement, and Evaluation for Large Language Models
title_zh: RLIE：面向大型语言模型、结合逻辑回归、迭代细化与评估的规则生成

sentences.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) can propose natural-language rules, circumventing the reliance on a predefined predicate space in traditional rule learning.
sentences.zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）能够提出自然语言规则，从而绕开了传统规则学习中对预定义谓词空间的依赖。

sentences.en: However, existing LLM-based methods often neglect the global interactions among rules, and the potential of using fine-grained rule importance scores to calibrate neuro-symbolic reasoning remains underexplored.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有的基于 LLM 的方法往往忽视了规则之间的全局交互，而利用细粒度规则重要性分数来校准神经符号推理的潜力仍未被充分探索。

sentences.en: To address this gap, we introduce RLIE, a framework that integrates LLMs with probabilistic modeling to learn weighted rule sets in four stages: (1) Rule generation: proposing and filtering candidate rules via LLMs;
sentences.zh: 为填补这一空白，我们提出 RLIE，一个将 LLMs 与概率建模相集成的框架，分四个阶段学习加权规则集：（1）规则生成：通过 LLMs 提出并筛选候选规则；

sentences.en: (2) Logistic regression: learning sparse, calibrated weights for global rule selection;
sentences.zh: （2）逻辑回归：为全局规则选择学习稀疏且经过校准的权重；

sentences.en: (3) Iterative refinement: revising the rule set with error-driven hard examples; and (4) Evaluation: validating the learned system via comparative inference paradigms.
sentences.zh: （3）迭代细化：用错误驱动的难例修订规则集；（4）评估：通过比较式推理范式验证学习到的系统。

sentences.en: Across multiple real-world datasets and LLM backbones, our learned weighted rules achieve superior stability and accuracy, whereas rule-injection prompting yields mixed results and often degrades performance.
sentences.zh: 在多个真实世界数据集和 LLM 骨干上，我们学习到的加权规则实现了更好的稳定性和准确性，而规则注入式提示则结果参差不齐，且常常降低性能。

sentences.en: These results suggest LLMs excel at semantic rule discovery but are less reliable at controlled probabilistic aggregation.
sentences.zh: 这些结果表明，LLMs 擅长语义规则的发现，但在受控的概率聚合方面可靠性较低。

sentences.en: Our findings highlight both the promise and the limits of LLMs for inductive reasoning, motivating a principled integration with classic probabilistic rule combination for reliable neuro-symbolic reasoning.
sentences.zh: 我们的发现既凸显了 LLMs 在归纳推理方面的潜力，也揭示了其局限性，从而促使人们与经典概率规则组合进行有依据的整合，以实现可靠的神经符号推理。

title_en: RLSF-V: Mitigating Hallucinations in MLLMs via Fuzzy Semantic Self-Feedback
title_zh: RLSF-V：通过模糊语义自反馈缓解多模态大语言模型的幻觉

sentences.en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) extend large language models (LLMs) with visual perception for open-world understanding, but exacerbate LLMs' hallucinations, in which generated text contradicts visual evidence or common sense.
sentences.zh: 多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）以视觉感知扩展了大型语言模型（LLMs）以实现开放世界理解，但同时加剧了 LLMs 的幻觉问题，即生成的文本与视觉证据或常识相矛盾。

sentences.en: To mitigate hallucinations, a dominant strategy is Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) using hallucination-labeled responses.
sentences.zh: 为缓解幻觉，一种主流策略是使用带幻觉标签的响应进行直接偏好优化（DPO）。

sentences.en: Existing pipelines, however, face two key limitations: they either (i) rely on human inspection or proprietary models to correct hallucinated outputs, producing off-policy preference data that violate the assumptions of DPO, or (ii) depend on stronger models to evaluate responses, leading to an unfavorable trade-off between performance and scalability.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有的流程面临两个关键局限：它们要么（i）依赖人工检查或专有模型来纠正幻觉输出，从而产生违反 DPO 假设的离策略偏好数据；要么（ii）依赖更强的模型来评估响应，导致性能与可扩展性之间出现不利的权衡。

sentences.en: Departing from these paradigms, we propose a reference-policy \emph{self-feedback} framework that constructs preference data for hallucination mitigation without any external supervision (\textit{e.g.}, large models or humans).
sentences.zh: 与这些范式不同，我们提出了一个基于参考策略的\emph{自反馈}框架，它在没有任何外部监督（\textit{例如}，大型模型或人类）的情况下为幻觉缓解构建偏好数据。

sentences.en: Specifically, we present a novel \emph{local fuzzy semantic} evaluation paradigm that derives a hallucination-sensitive confidence signal directly from the internal logits, which is then used to automatically rank diverse generated responses to build preference pairs for fine-tuning.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们提出一种新颖的\emph{局部模糊语义}评估范式，它直接从内部 logits 中推导出对幻觉敏感的置信度信号，然后用该信号自动对多样化的生成响应进行排序，以构建用于微调的偏好对。

sentences.en: Trained on a 10k-scale dataset, our method achieves competitive performance on both generative and discriminative benchmarks compared to existing RLHF and RLAIF baselines.
sentences.zh: 在 10k 规模数据集上训练后，与现有的 RLHF 和 RLAIF 基线相比，我们的方法在生成式和判别式基准上都取得了有竞争力的性能。

title_en: RLVE: Scaling Up Reinforcement Learning for Language Models with Adaptive Verifiable Environments
title_zh: RLVE：利用自适应可验证环境扩展语言模型的强化学习规模

sentences.en: We introduce Reinforcement Learning (RL) with Adaptive Verifiable Environments (RLVE), an approach using verifiable environments that procedurally generate problems and provide algorithmically verifiable rewards, to scale up RL for language models (LMs).
sentences.zh: 我们提出带自适应可验证环境的强化学习（RLVE），这是一种利用可验证环境（程序化生成问题并提供算法上可验证的奖励）来扩展语言模型（LMs）强化学习规模的方法。

sentences.en: RLVE enables each verifiable environment to dynamically adapt its problem difficulty distribution to the policy model's capabilities as training progresses.
sentences.zh: RLVE 使每个可验证环境能够随训练的进行，动态地使其问题难度分布适应当前策略模型的能力。

sentences.en: In contrast, static data distributions often lead to vanishing learning signals when problems are either too easy or too hard for the policy.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，当问题对策略而言过易或过难时，静态数据分布往往会导致学习信号消失。

sentences.en: To implement RLVE, we create RLVE-Gym, a large-scale suite of 400 verifiable environments carefully developed through manual environment engineering.
sentences.zh: 为实现 RLVE，我们创建了 RLVE-Gym，一个通过人工环境工程精心开发的大型可验证环境套件，包含 400 个环境。

sentences.en: Using RLVE-Gym, we show that environment scaling, i.e., expanding the collection of training environments, consistently improves generalizable reasoning capabilities.
sentences.zh: 借助 RLVE-Gym，我们表明环境扩展（即扩大训练环境的集合）能持续提高可泛化的推理能力。

sentences.en: RLVE with joint training across all 400 environments in RLVE-Gym yields a 3.37% absolute average improvement across six reasoning benchmarks, starting from one of the strongest 1.5B reasoning LMs.
sentences.zh: 在 RLVE-Gym 的全部 400 个环境上进行联合训练的 RLVE，从最强推理 LMs 之一的 1.5B 模型出发，在六个推理基准上取得了 3.37% 的平均绝对提升。

sentences.en: By comparison, continuing this LM's original RL training yields only a 0.49% average absolute gain despite using over 3x more compute.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，即使使用超过 3 倍的计算量，继续该 LM 原有的 RL 训练也仅获得 0.49% 的平均绝对增益。

sentences.en: We release our code publicly.
sentences.zh: 我们公开了我们的代码。

title_en: RMNP: Row-Momentum Normalized Preconditioning for Scalable Matrix-Based Optimization
title_zh: RMNP：面向可扩展矩阵优化的行动量归一化预条件

sentences.en: Preconditioned adaptive methods have gained significant attention for training deep neural networks, as they capture rich curvature information of the loss landscape .
sentences.zh: 预条件自适应方法已引起广泛关注，用于训练深度神经网络，因为它们能捕捉损失曲面的丰富曲率信息。

sentences.en: The central challenge in this field lies in balancing preconditioning effectiveness with computational efficiency of implementing the preconditioner.
sentences.zh: 该领域的核心挑战在于平衡预条件的有效性与实现预条件子的计算效率。

sentences.en: Among recent advances, Muon stands out by using Newton-Schulz iteration to obtain preconditioned updates without explicitly constructing the preconditioning matrix.
sentences.zh: 在近期的进展中，Muon 因其使用 Newton-Schulz 迭代来获得预条件更新且无需显式构造预条件矩阵而尤为突出。

sentences.en: Despite its advantages, the efficiency of Muon still leaves room for further improvement.
sentences.zh: 尽管具有这些优势，Muon 的效率仍有进一步提升的空间。

sentences.en: In this paper, we introduce RMNP (Row Momentum Normalized Preconditioning), an optimizer that replaces Newton-Schulz iteration with a simple row-wise($d_{\text{in}}$) $\ell_2$ normalization operation, motivated by the empirically observed diagonal block structure of the Transformer layerwise Hessian.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出 RMNP（行动量归一化预条件，Row Momentum Normalized Preconditioning），这是一种用简单的按行（$d_{\text{in}}$）$\ell_2$ 归一化操作替代 Newton-Schulz 迭代的优化器，其动机来自经验观察到的 Transformer 逐层 Hessian 的对角块结构。

sentences.en: We empirically verified that orthogonalization and row-wise(on input dim) $\ell_2$ normalization are asymptotically equivalent in the case of the transformer.
sentences.zh: 我们通过实验验证，在 Transformer 的情况下，正交化与按行（输入维度）$\ell_2$ 归一化渐近等价。

sentences.en: This substitution reduces the per-iteration computational complexity from $\mathcal{O}(mn\cdot\min(m,n))$ to $\mathcal{O}(mn)$ for an $m\times n$ weight matrix while maintaining comparable optimization performance.
sentences.zh: 对于 $m\times n$ 的权重矩阵，这种替代将每次迭代的计算复杂度从 $\mathcal{O}(mn\cdot\min(m,n))$ 降到 $\mathcal{O}(mn)$，同时保持可比的优化性能。

sentences.en: Theoretically, we establish convergence guarantees for RMNP in the non-convex setting that match recent results for Muon optimizers, achieving the minimax optimal complexity.
sentences.zh: 在理论上，我们在非凸设置中为 RMNP 建立了收敛性保证，这与 Muon 优化器的最新结果相当，达到了极小极大最优复杂度。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on large language model pretraining show that RMNP delivers competitive optimization performance compared with Muon while substantially reducing preconditioning wall-clock time.
sentences.zh: 在大型语言模型预训练上的大量实验表明，与 Muon 相比，RMNP 在提供有竞争力的优化性能的同时，大幅减少了预条件的墙钟时间。

sentences.en: Our code is available at https://github.com/Dominator-Index/RMNP
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 https://github.com/Dominator-Index/RMNP 获取。

title_en: RN-D: Discretized Categorical Actors for On-Policy Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: RN-D：面向在线策略强化学习的离散化分类行动者

sentences.en: On-policy Reinforcement Learning (RL) remains a dominant paradigm for continuous control, yet standard implementations rely on Gaussian actors and relatively shallow MLP policies, often leading to brittle optimization when gradients are noisy, and policy updates must be conservative.
sentences.zh: 在线策略强化学习（RL）仍然是连续控制的主导范式，然而标准的实现依赖高斯行动者和相对较浅的 MLP 策略，当梯度带有噪声时必须采用保守的策略更新，这常常导致脆弱的优化。

sentences.en: In this paper, we revisit actor policy representation as a first-class design choice for on-policy RL.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们重新审视行动者策略表示，将其视为在线策略 RL 的一等设计选择。

sentences.en: We study discretized categorical actors, which represent each action dimension as a distribution over discrete bins and induce a policy objective analogous to classification cross-entropy loss.
sentences.zh: 我们研究离散化分类行动者，它将每个动作维度表示为离散分箱上的分布，并催生一个类似于分类交叉熵损失的策略目标。

sentences.en: Building on architectural advances from supervised learning, we further pair discretized categorical actors with regularized networks, yielding RN-D. Across diverse continuous-control benchmarks, we show that simply replacing the standard Gaussian actor with our proposed actor substantially improves performance, achieving state-of-the-art results within on-policy RL.
sentences.zh: 基于监督学习中架构方面的进展，我们进一步将离散化分类行动者与正则化网络配对，得到 RN-D。在多种多样的连续控制基准上，我们表明，仅用我们提出的行动者替换标准高斯行动者就能大幅提升性能，在在线策略 RL 中达到最先进的结果。

sentences.en: We release our code at https://github.com/alwaysbyx/RND-RL.
sentences.zh: 我们在 https://github.com/alwaysbyx/RND-RL 发布我们的代码。

title_en: RNA-FM: Flow-Matching Generative Model for Genome-wide RNA-Seq Prediction
title_zh: RNA-FM：用于全基因组 RNA-Seq 预测的流匹配生成模型

sentences.en: Histopathology whole-slide images (WSIs) are routinely acquired in clinical practice and contain rich tissue morphology but lack direct molecular architecture and functional programs defining pathological states, whereas RNA sequencing (RNA-seq) provides genome-wide transcriptional profiles at substantial cost, thereby motivating WSI-based genome-wide transcriptomic prediction.
sentences.zh: 组织病理学全切片图像（WSIs）在临床实践中常规采集，包含丰富的组织形态，但缺乏定义病理状态的直接分子结构和功能程序；而 RNA 测序（RNA-seq）能以高昂成本提供全基因组转录谱，因此推动了基于 WSI 的全基因组转录组预测。

sentences.en: Existing approaches for predicting gene expression from WSIs predominantly rely on deterministic regression with one-to-one mapping, limiting their ability to capture biological heterogeneity and predictive uncertainty.
sentences.zh: 现有的从 WSI 预测基因表达的方法主要依赖一对一映射的确定性回归，限制了它们捕捉生物异质性和预测不确定性的能力。

sentences.en: We propose RNA-FM, a flow-matching generative framework for genome-wide bulk RNA-seq prediction from WSIs.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 RNA-FM，一个用于从 WSI 进行全基因组批量 RNA-seq 预测的流匹配生成框架。

sentences.en: RNA-FM formulates transcriptomic prediction as a continuous-time conditional transport problem, learning a velocity field that maps a simple prior to the target gene expression distribution conditioned on morphologies.
sentences.zh: RNA-FM 将转录组预测表述为一个连续时间条件传输问题，学习一个将简单先验映射到以形态为条件的目标准因表达分布的速度场。

sentences.en: By integrating pathway-level structure, RNA-FM enables scalable and biologically interpretable genome-wide gene expression imputation.
sentences.zh: 通过整合通路层面的结构，RNA-FM 实现了可扩展且生物学上可解释的全基因组基因表达填补。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that RNA-FM consistently outperforms state-of-the-art approaches while maintaining biological meaningfulness.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，RNA-FM 在保持生物学意义的同时持续优于最先进的方法。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/YXSong000/RNA-FM.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/YXSong000/RNA-FM 获取。

title_en: ROAMM: A Benchmark Dataset for Multimodal Human Attention Decoding and EEG-to-Text Modeling During Naturalistic Reading
title_zh: ROAMM：自然阅读中多模态人类注意力解码与脑电-文本建模的基准数据集

sentences.en: We present Reading Observed At Mindless Moments (ROAMM), a multimodal dataset comprising 50 hours of simultaneous EEG and eye-tracking recordings collected during naturalistic multi-page reading from 44 participants.
sentences.zh: 我们提出无意识时刻的阅读观测（ROAMM）数据集，这是一个多模态数据集，包含从 44 名参与者在自然主义多页阅读过程中采集的 50 小时同步脑电（EEG）和眼动追踪记录。

sentences.en: ROAMM includes synchronized physiological recordings, eye-movement events, page-level comprehension scores, and span-level mind-wandering (MW) annotations obtained using a retrospective self-report paradigm.
sentences.zh: ROAMM 包含同步的生理记录、眼动事件、页面级理解得分，以及使用回溯性自我报告范式获得的片段级走神（MW）标注。

sentences.en: We introduce a standardized leave-one-subject-out benchmark for MW detection and achieve up to 0.609 AUROC using supervised models.
sentences.zh: 我们为走神检测引入了一个标准化的留一被试（leave-one-subject-out）基准，并使用监督模型取得了高达 0.609 的 AUROC。

sentences.en: We additionally evaluate EEG-to-text decoding on reading segments with and without MW labels, showing that decoding performance decreases during MW episodes.
sentences.zh: 我们还在带与不带走神标签的阅读片段上评估了脑电到文本的解码，结果表明在走神阶段解码性能会下降。

sentences.en: ROAMM enables research on MW detection, EEG-to-text decoding, multimodal representation learning, and attention-related degradation of language representations during naturalistic reading.
sentences.zh: ROAMM 支持关于走神检测、脑电到文本解码、多模态示示学习，以及自然阅读中与注意力相关的语言表示退化等研究。

title_en: RoboFlow4D: A Lightweight Flow World Model Toward Real-Time Flow-Guided Robotic Manipulation
title_zh: RoboFlow4D：面向实时流引导机器人操作的轻量级流世界模型

sentences.en: Planning and acting in 3D environments is a fundamental capability for robotic manipulation in the real world.
sentences.zh: 在 3D 环境中进行规划与执行是现实世界中机器人操作的一项基本能力。

sentences.en: Although prior work has explored predictive flow planners to guide 3D manipulation, existing approaches often rely on modular pipelines stacking multiple submodels, resulting in high computational overhead and limited real-time performance.
sentences.zh: 尽管先前的工作已经探索了用于指导 3D 操作的预测式流规划器，但现有的方法往往依赖堆叠多个子模型的模块化流水线，导致较高的计算开销和有限的实时性能。

sentences.en: To address these challenges, we introduce RoboFlow4D, a lightweight flow world model that unifies perception and planning by estimating temporal motion in physical 3D space.
sentences.zh: 为解决这些挑战，我们提出 RoboFlow4D，一个轻量级的流世界模型，它通过估计物理 3D 空间中的时间运动来统一感知与规划。

sentences.en: As an end-to-end framework, RoboFlow4D directly predicts multi-frame 3D flows from visual observations and textual instructions, providing explicit flow-based planning to guide action generation.
sentences.zh: 作为一个端到端框架，RoboFlow4D 直接从视觉观测和文本指令中预测多帧 3D 流，提供显式的基于流的规划来指导动作生成。

sentences.en: This design allows seamless integration with general action policies, forming an efficient observation–planning–execution closed loop.
sentences.zh: 这种设计允许与通用动作策略无缝集成，形成高效的观测–规划–执行闭环。

sentences.en: Through slow–fast collaboration between flow prediction and action control, RoboFlow4D enables real-time and resource-efficient manipulation.
sentences.zh: 通过在流预测与动作控制之间的慢–快协作，RoboFlow4D 实现了实时且资源高效的操作。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments in both simulation and real-world settings demonstrate that RoboFlow4D consistently improves manipulation success rates and computational efficiency, advancing flow-guided planning for embodied intelligence.
sentences.zh: 在仿真和真实世界环境中的大量实验表明，RoboFlow4D 持续提高操作成功率和计算效率，推动了具身智能中流引导规划的发展。

sentences.zh: 我们的项目页面可在 RoboFlow4D 获取。
